I.V. extension tube in flexible, transparent polyurethane tubing with Vadsite and flat clamp. Octopus with Vadsite is a multi-purpose catheter accessory, a single lumen or multi-lumen I.V. extension tube with needleless connector(s), enabling intermittent injections or continuous infusions of fluids or medications and blood sampling depending on device variant. The variants with anti-reflux valves negate the risk of backtracking (retrogate flow) of infusate and thus the risk of overmedication (drug overdose). It is not possible to withdraw blood/fluid via an octopus where the lumen features an anti-reflux valve. Use with peripheral short IV cannulae, Octopus 1 and Octopus 2 have the following advantages: – Eliminates the risk of access-associated needle-stick injury – Reduces the risk of cannula movement in the vein causing mechanical vein irritation – Negates the need to use the cannula injection port (non disinfectable), Vadsite is disinfectable – Eliminates the need to use a 3-way tap to run simultaneous compatible solutions – Provides closed system (avoiding blood reflux) when accessing the catheter – PUR material (no PVC, DEHP-free), no leaching of plasticizers. Octopus 3, 4 and 5 are mostly recommended for use with central venous catheters. In this application, they have the following advantages: – Provide closed, neelde-free access during drug bolusing and continuous administration of I.V. fluids – Eliminate the need to use a 3-way tap to run 2 or more simultaneous compatible solutions – Eliminate the risk of blood spillage – Eliminate the risk of air embolism – PUR material (no PVC, no DEHP), no leaching of plasticizers.

Bionector TKO® is a patented “To Keep Open” valve, with 100% bi-directional fluid control and a straight fluid pathway. Bionector TKO has been specifically designed to reduce catheter occlusion, and works by controlling the bi-directional flow of fluid, infusate and catheter tip blood reflux. Occlusions can be commonplace in patients with vascular access lines, which both costs you money and affects your patients.This is accepted as normal, with occlusions and their consequences being dealt with as a matter of routine.The most common are: thrombotic occlusion when blood or clotting agents accumulate inside the catheter and persistent withdrawal occlusion when fibrin is aspirated into the catheter. This is where Bionector TKO can benefit you, it is clinically shown to reduce; catheter occlusions by 88% (50.4 to 5.8 per 1,000 catheter days)*, loss of IV catheter by 91% (9% to 0.8%)* and tissue plasminogen activator (tPA) usage by 85%*. *references available on request.

Bionector is an established market-leading needle-free device which meets the full range of global opinion leaders’ recommendations for reducing CRBSIs. It has been proven to provide an effective barrier against microbial ingress and help standardise practice by combining a fixed, straight fluid pathway with innovative neutral displacement technology. And it is the only neutral displacement needle-free device in the UK to combine a split-septum with a fixed straight, fluid pathway. Benefits: Bionector leads the way with a neutral fluid displacement. This means a specific post-flushing clamping sequence is not required, which in turn helps prevent blood reflux and reduce catheter occlusions. It is also backed up by a robust library of clinical studies, Bionector is proven to be easy to clean and clear. Its smooth split-septum fits tightly into the device housing ensuring it is free from any gaps. The straight, fixed fluid pathway has been proven ‘easy to clear’, designed to provide the most direct and least tortuous route with no moving parts (such as mechanical valves), which reduces the surface area available for biofilm formation. Aswell as being proven not to represent any risk to either patients or practitioners during an MRI of up to three Teslas. CT-rated for use with power injectors Bionector has a maximum pressure resistance of 350psi and a maximum flow rate of 10ml/s. Plus, Bionector’s straight fluid pathway is proven ‘flushable’ for macro and microscopic particles such as blood. This is due to a minimal deadspace of just 0.03ml allowing for a low flushing volume (5ml) to clear the device. Clean in accordance with your hospital/department protocol; Bionector can be cleaned with most disinfecting agents (eg 70% alcohol). Avoid antiseptics containing both alcohol and hydrogen peroxide.

It has been proven to provide an effective barrier against microbial ingress and help standardise practice by combining a fixed, straight fluid pathway with innovative neutral displacement technology. And it is the only neutral displacement needle-free device in the UK to combine a split-septum with a fixed straight, fluid pathway. Benefits: Bionector leads the way with a neutral fluid displacement.This means a specific post-flushing clamping sequence is not required, which in turn helps prevent blood reflux and reduce catheter occlusions. It is also backed up by a robust library of clinical studies, Bionector is proven to be easy to clean and clear. Its smooth split-septum fits tightly into the device housing ensuring it is free from any gaps.The straight, fixed fluid pathway has been proven ‘easy to clear’, designed to provide the most direct and least tortuous route with no moving parts (such as mechanical valves), which reduces the surface area available for biofilm formation. Aswell as being proven not to represent any risk to either patients or practitioners during an MRI of up to threeTeslas. CT-rated for use with power injectors Bionector has a maximum pressure resistance of 350psi and a maximum flow rate of 10ml/s. Plus, Bionector’s straight fluid pathway is proven ‘flushable’ for macro and microscopic particles such as blood.This is due to a minimal deadspace of just 0.018ml allowing for a low flushing volume (5ml) to clear the device. Clean in accordance with your hospital/department protocol; Bionector can be cleaned with most disinfecting agents (eg 70% alcohol). Avoid antiseptics containing both alcohol and hydrogen peroxide.

Respiratory assistance device for patients with spontaneous ventilation allowing maintenance in the airways of a pressure greater than atmospheric pressure during the entire respiratory cycle. The CPAP mode of ventilation allows: – to recruit collapsed alveoles – to restore a satisfactory level of functional residual capacity – to improve gas exchange at the level of the alveolocapillary membrane – to decrease pulmonary resistance – to decrease the work of breathing – to redistribute the alveolar liquid to the interstitial space in case of acute pulmonary oedema. The Boussignac CPAP and its manometer connector is a device for connection to a face mask with its 22 mm male connector, the crenellated upper part remaining open to the air. This device comprises 2 lateral ports: – the upper port is preconnected to an extension tube (length 200 cm) for connection to an air or oxygen source – the bottom port (colourless translucent) allows: . controlling pressure (use manometer code 527.01), . an additional oxygen supply if the gas administered to the patient via the upper port is air, . CO2 monitoring How it works: The gases administered to the patient (air, air-oxygen mixture or pure oxygen) pass through the extension tube and arrive in a circular chamber where the gases can only escape into the central zone passing through 4 micro-channels. At that moment, the injection speed of the gases is greatly increased. Deflectors at the exit site of the micro-channels eject the gases arriving at high speed towards the opposite wall. The collision of gas molecules between themselves generates a turbulence which creates a virtual valve and simultaneously the speed of gases is transformed in pressure. This pressure depends directly on the flowrate: if the flowrate (the amount of gas injected) is increased, the pressure will increase; if the flowrate is decreased, the pressure will decrease. N.B. It is possible to connect the Boussignac CPAP to an endotracheal tube or to a tracheosto

The connecting tube is supplied in the packaging containing the VYGON-BOUSSIGNAC CPAP code 5570.13. The manometer must be connected to the colourless translucent port on the CPAP device. It indicates each centimetre of H2O from 0 to 25cm. The manometer is encased in a protective polyurethane housing and is supplied with a manometer attachment cord (code 7.254.15.03).

Transform Your Medical Practice Today >> Outpatient Care Settings and Use Cases Ambulatory Surgery Centers (pre-op, intra-op procedural rooms, PACU) In the fast-paced environment of an ASC, patient safety and workflow efficiency are paramount. Our ASC monitoring solutions offer a seamless continuum of care, spanning from patient arrival to discharge. A patient arriving for a procedure is first assessed in the preoperative area using a monitor for a spot check of vital signs. Once in the procedural room, clinical monitors provide continuous monitoring of ECG, SpO2, and NIBP throughout the surgery. In the post anesthesia care unit (PACU), the system continues to track the patient's recovery, with customized alarm settings alerting staff to any potential complications. During the various stages of the patient's journey, documentation is integrated into the electronic medical record (EMR) to create a comprehensive and accurate patient record.

Primary Care and Specialty Clinics (cardiology, GI, pulmonary) Specialty clinics require targeted outpatient monitoring to manage chronic conditions, perform diagnostic tests, and assess treatment. Our clinical monitors offer the precision needed for specialized care. A cardiology clinic can use our outpatient heart monitors for in-office stress tests, capturing continuous ECG data. For routine follow-ups, a spot check of blood pressure and oxygen saturation provides a quick snapshot of the patient's status. In a GI or pulmonary procedural suite, the monitors offer the right level of surveillance for conscious sedation, ensuring patient safety without the complexity of a full-scale operating room (OR) setup. Alarms are configured to the specific parameters of the procedure, minimizing false alerts while maximizing responsiveness.

Urgent Care and Dialysis, Imaging, Procedural Sites These diverse settings handle a high volume of patients with varying acuity levels, demanding monitoring solutions that are both robust and user-friendly. Our equipment supports efficient triage, procedural safety, and routine patient assessment. An urgent care center can utilize our outpatient vital signs monitors for rapid triage, quickly obtaining a full set of vital signs to assess patient acuity. During a minor procedure, the device can switch to continuous monitoring mode. For a dialysis center, routine pre- and post-treatment spot checks are simple and fast, with data easily documented. The intuitive user interface ensures that staff with varying levels of training can operate the devices confidently, making our outpatient monitoring systems a practical choice for any environment.

3rd Harmonic Imaging AI-enabled innovation for more detail and depth 3rd Harmonic Imaging (3-HI) is a technology that utilizes the frequency components of the ultrasound beam at three times the transmitted frequency. Developmentally, to extract the 3rd harmonic components from the huge quantity of received signals, an AI filter for 3rd harmonic was designed using deep learning that allows the effective extraction and utilization of the 3rd harmonic signal. Using the 3rd harmonic sharpens the received beam, reduces multiple reflections and sidelobes, and achieves B-mode images with less noise in the vessel lumen and clearer tissue structures around the vessel. Please accept preferences-cookies to watch this video. Deep Learning The deep learning methods of the Deep Convolutional Neural Network (DCNN) are able to process enormous amounts of data through an network of decision making nodes, or neurons, and are well regarded for their excellent performance in image recognition-based applications. Deep Learning Reconstruction (DLR) AiCE was trained on vast amounts of high-SNR MRI images reconstructed with an advanced algorithm that is too computationally intensive for clinical use. This training taught AiCE to distinguish true signal from noise. The results were validated by a team of radiologists, medical physicists, AI scientists, and clinical researchers, producing a fast, fully-trained reconstruction algorithm ready for clinical use. The DCNN learns which methods are best applied to maintain the spatial resolution and low-noise properties contained in high SNR MR images. The more variations of data supplied during training, the better the final algorithm will perform in terms of image quality and processing speeds. The DCNN essentially programs itself as it learns, to become more accurate and more efficient with every new training task. The training is monitored by an engineer with expertise

detail.description: Bivona ™ FlexTend ™ TTS ™ Neonatal and Paediatric Tracheostomy Tubes Bivona ™ FlexTend ™ TTS ™ Neonatal and Paediatric Tracheostomy Tubes Why Select Portex Bivona FlexTend TTS Neonatal and Paediatric Tracheostomy Tubes? Bivona FlexTend TTS Tracheostomy Tubes are designed for neonatal and paediatric patients who require intermittent or temporary cuff use. A cuff, when inflated, helps create a seal between the tube’s outer wall and the trachea to direct airflow through the inner lumen, protecting against aspiration and optimising respiration in ventilated patients and patients performing lung expansion therapies. When the seal is no longer needed, the cuff can be deflated, and it rests Tight-to-Shaft (TTS), reducing the risk of trauma to the trachea and allowing the patient to speak. ¹ ' ² Bivona FlexTend TTS Tracheostomy Tubes can be reprocessed up to five times and are made of soft, natural, biocompatible silicone that is intended to be gentle on sensitive body tissues. A SuperSlick ™ coating applied to the silicone surfaces aids in tube insertion, removal, cleaning, and reinsertion, most beneficial to patients, clinicians, and home care providers. detail.description: Level 1 ™ Convective Warmer Device Level 1 ™ Convective Warmer Device The Level 1 Convective Warming System consists of a high-flow convective warmer with hose-end temperature control, a convective warming blanket, and accessories. The convective warmer draws ambient-temperature air through a HEPA air filter. The filtered air is warmed to a selected temperature. The warmed air enters the convective warming blanket through the hose and is distributed through delivery channels. Perforations on the patient side of the blanket gently disperse warm air over the patient. The safety circuit provides an independent means to discontinue power to the heater. This design prevents exposing the patient to excessive temperatures, while continuously monitoring over and under temperature alarms for each setting. Request More Information When you're working to save a patient's life, every second counts. When lives are at stake from significant blood loss due to trauma or major surgery, the Level 1 Fast Flow Fluid Warmer provides a rapid flow of normothermic blood and IV fluids. Even a small drop in body temperature can be detrimental — delaying recovery or allowing infection to set in. Level 1 H-1200 Fast Flow Fluid Warmers allow rapid infusion of warm fluids while providing the extra level of protection of an integrated Air Detector/Clamp. Upon detection of air in the line, the flow of blood and crystalloid is automatically stopped, allowing quick removal of air and restoration of flow without disconnecting from the patient or changing disposable administration sets. Different disposable sets are available for a variety of clinical applications. detail.description: Level 1 ™ Myocardial Temperature Sensors Level 1 ™ Myocardial Temperature Sensors The Level 1 Myocardial Temperature Sensor is indicated for temperature monitoring of the myocardium, especially when using hypothermic cardioplegia. The sensor is designed for insertion directly into the myocardium. The Level 1 Myocardial Temperature Sensor utilizes a “400” series thermistor that is placed at the tip of a 22 gauge thin wall needle. The needle is formed at a right angle to a molded plastic hub to assure better fixation with a low profile. The sensor’s lead wires are terminated by an electrical connector that facilitates interconnection with the temperature monitoring system. The lead wires are 1.8 meters (6 feet) long. The needle is electrically insulated from the lead wires. The temperature sensor is in the form of an electrically insulated “400” series thermistor. detail.description: Level 1 ™ Tympanic Temperature Sensors Level 1 ™ Tympanic Temperature Sensors Monitoring of tympanic temperature is a well accepted clinical procedure for the detection of hypothermic or hyperthermic conditions. The Level 1 tympanic temperature sensor is designed for atraumatic placement in the proximity of the tympanic membrane. The sensor is placed in the center of a PVC foam cylinder. Prior to insertion, the foam cylinder is squeezed and rolled to obtain a small dimension which, once the sensor is in situ, expands to its original size, making physical contact with the walls of the ear canal. The foam expansion produces two effects: it secures the sensor in place, and it prevents communication of air from outside the ear canal. The expansion results in accurate temperature measurement even when the sensor is not touching the tympanic membrane. detail.description: Normoflo ™ Irrigation Fluid Warmer Normoflo ™ Irrigation Fluid Warmer The Normoflo irrigation fluid warmer delivers large volumes of warmed irrigating fluids at optimum flow rates. The device helps you maintain your patient’s core temperature during the entire length of the procedure, helping to prevent unintended perioperative hypothermia (UPH). UPH (core body temperature below 36°C) is a common yet preventable consequence of surgery under general anesthesia. Adverse outcomes of UPH include cardiac morbidity, intraoperative blood loss, thermal discomfort, increased wound infection rates, prolonged recovery times, and extended hospital stays. ¹ Research shows that using room-temperature fluids may contribute to perioperative hypothermia. ² That’s why the Association of periOperative Registered Nurses (AORN) Guidelines for Prevention of Hypothermia recommends warm irrigation fluids, an active method to help maintain patient normothermia and improve recovery outcomes. ³ ICU Medical offers two irrigation options. The H1100 is intended for gravity flow procedures, while the H-1129 offers the same features plus pressurized fluid delivery via integrated pressure chambers as well as 3-lit
features: Delivers large volumes of warmed irrigation fluid at flow rates of > 2,000 mL/min.
Both irrigation models allow quick and easy bag changes with the electrical IV pole that can automatically lift up to four 3-liter bags of fluid.

Surgical solutions Trays Our surgical trays Our customised procedure trays contain all the products and solutions needed for a surgical procedure. Highlighting the ability to include everything you need for a specific intervention in a single procedure tray, the procedure tray category shows the value and efficiency of customisation. Time saving with ProcedurePak® tray vs single-packed Mölnlycke customised procedure trays are assembled to contain all the single-use components required for a particular surgical intervention. Replacing a large number of individually packaged items, ProcedurePak trays can generate significant savings in time and costs for both major and minor surgery procedures. Preparation time for surgical procedures can be cut by more than half compared to traditional preparation of the operation room. Increasing OR efficiency Hospitals and healthcare managers around the world are finding better ways to improve internal processes to save time and increase efficiency in the operating room. Their goals include improving outcomes while ensuring quality and safety. That involves making best use of the resources they have, easing the stress on healthcare professionals s

detail.description: This Bariatric Plus Chair is a robust bariatric lift chair that offers staff a safe working practice and improves the patient experience. The heavy duty transport chair is approved for a user weight of up to 300 kg/660 pounds and is suitable for rehabilitation, training and as a patient chair in the wards.

This Bariatric Chair is a robust and secure hospital chair designed to support bariatric patients during seated procedures, such as mammography and eye examinations, while optimizing staff workflows and enhancing patient comfort.
A durable, washable, and space-saving extra bed for hospitals. Easy to use, store, and move.

The HYGI portable sink provides a practical washing solution without needing a water supply, ideal for individuals with limited mobility or requiring bedside care. It enables personal hygiene activities such as handwashing, shaving, or hair washing, enhancing independence and dignity. Its height-adjustable and compact telescopic design ensures ease of use and storage. Equipped with a double basin and tap, it simplifies carers’ tasks by eliminating the need to carry water to the bedside. No installation is required.

These Medical Practitioner Chairs with Tilt are available with or without multi-adjustable arms and feature comfortable, contoured back support with dual adjustment, a pneumatic height adjustment, a black base with hard, free-wheeling castor wheels, integrated footrest ring and a full 360° range of motion. These luxury high-back chairs are available in a choice of versatile and hardwearing anti-microbial vinyl upholstery colours.

The ceiling IV stand enables the attachment of medical infusion bags on a ceiling rail system via a glider or ceiling hook. This solution frees up space for other equipment that is stored around the patient’s bed which makes for a more efficient and safe working environment. The stand has six options to cater for different ceiling heights, from 2.5,m to 3.5 m and has simple and ergonomic height adjustment that can be operated with one hand. Each stand has 4 suspension hooks plus there is an optional infusion pump holder.

Out and about is where it really shines. With up to 19.2 km (11.9 miles) of range, it’s ready for long days that roll into the evening. A roomier foot platform lets you sit more naturally too, especially if you’re tall. Plus, it’s built with decades of trusted STERLING know-how, giving you reliability you can feel. That’s pavement-hugging control at every corner – for a smoother ride, a reduced risk of tipping, and one less thing to think about. Built for Comfort. Many foldable mobility scooters can feel cramped when you’re seated, with the front taking up valuable space and limiting how naturally you can position your legs (especially if you’re tall). Looks good. Feels great . The 50 mm (2” deep) seat cushion gives you extra padding you’ll notice straight away – especially on longer trips. And we’ve got your back too: a gently curved backrest supports a more natural sitting position, while breathable spacer fabric allows airflow to help reduce heat build-up, keeping you cooler on warmer days.

detail.description: Go longer distances without fatigue, easily ascend ramps, and reduce stress on your shoulders. The eye-catching Empulse R90 powers your push with ease. The sleek, simple, and compact design allows the R90 to sit under your chair. It’s inconspicuous and intuitive & maintains your chair’s size and turning circle. The V-Lock attachment system secures the R90 to most folding and rigid wheelchairs. The simple Control Box enables easy push-button use and can be ergonomically positioned for easy use. When power assist is not needed, simply push a button to raise the wheel up for zero rolling resistance. The Sunrise Intelligence app allows you to select the performance profile that best suits your environment. Limited hand grasp or dexterity? With the R90’s wireless Control Box, you can start and control your speed with the push of a button. Conveniently attachable to any part of your wheelchair’s frame, it allows you to: Raise or lower the wheel any time. Adjust your speed as needed: lower in crowded rooms, or higher to match your dog’s pace, with a top speed of 5.5 mph. Get moving by pressing the plus (+) button, or propel to the speed you want and press the plus (+) button to maintain it, like cruise control. The Control Box wirelessly connects to the R90 using Bluetooth®, ensuring there’s no cable in your way. It maintains a reliable connection no matter your movement and can be easily detached for transfers or to prevent damage during flights. There’s no learning curve; just faster, slower, wheel up, or GO! The Empulse R90 is compatible with most rigid and folding wheelchairs. The reciever brackets don’t interfere with chair components, and still allow folding chairs to fold.

detail.description: Quickie’s smallest and lightest manual wheelchair pull device ever! When using your wheelchair, every little push forward might not feel like a big deal, but day in, day out, the strain on your shoulders accumulates over time. Pull assist devices can be the superheroes of the wheelchair world, but some are just too bulky and heavy for everyday use – especially for quick jaunts around town or when travelling. The Empulse F35 strikes the perfect balance between size and practicality. This ultra-portable micro-pull device is not just a looker, it’s your ticket to quick and effortless powered mobility in the urban jungle. At 7.5 kg, the F35 is lighter to lift than most wheelchairs! But it’s not just its weight that makes the F35 so easy to handle, it’s the integrated design too. From cabling to the battery, everything is included in its frame tube, so there’s less to lift. Tight on space? The handles also fold down flush to the frame, saving you additional space when you really need it. Places to go? People to see? That’s why we’ve made docking your F35 so easy. Just pull the tube latch and the F35 releases from its sub-frame – how simple is that? The sub-frame can stay on your wheelchair all day too, so re-attaching is a breeze. Just align and push forward to lock back in. And when it’s time to transfer out of your wheelchair, the sub-frame is just as easy to remove too. Flights booked? All that’s left to do is to enjoy your holiday thanks to the F35 and its IATA (International Air Transport Association) approved battery, which is safe for air travel. And if that isn’t enough, the F35 has a variety of options to help further take the worry out of travel too.

products.name: Sunrise Empulse WheelDrive Wheelchair Power Assist

detail.description: WheelDrive not only offers extra pushing power when propelling, it is also allows you continously drive without self propelling thanks to the unique double rim system. Further away, difficult slopes, thresholds or maneuvering in a small space? You choose the support you need and you remain active and mobile with your own wheelchair! In addition, the driving characteristics of the WheelDrive are easy to program according to your wishes. The WheelDrive stimulates active movement, while strain on muscles and joints is reduced. With a unique dual hand rims concept the WheelDrive stands apart from other power assist wheels The large hand ring provides additional support while you are propelling. While the small hand ring gives you a continuous drive so when you come to a tricky hill you can reserve your energy. With both rims you can select from three speed settings, each of which can be tailored to your specific requirements! The power assist wheels can be fitted to virtually any lightweight or standard wheelchair without the need for additional parts or modifications to the chair. So you can continue to use your own manual wheelchair, additionally adapted to your specific needs. Of course, you can swap the wheels again at any time and switch to the original manual wheels – without additional tools.

detail.description: Introducing the RAYMEX ® Lift, a portable, personal fall recovery device that also doubles as a better alternative to a rollator walker. Designed to help people maintain their independence and active lifestyle as they age, the RAYMEX ® Lift aids with everyday activities while also always being ready to lift a fallen person from the floor. The RAYMEX ® combines a walker, lifting chair, stand aid, and lowering device in one piece of equipment, helping older adults maintain their independence and mobility. Whether it’s baking a cake, playing with your grandchildren, or simply sitting in your favourite chair, the RAYMEX® Lift helps you keep doing the things you love. Benefits of the RAYMEX ® Multiple use cases in one piece of equipment – The RAYMEX ® Lift is designed to do more than lift. It can double as a walker or stand aid, supporting individuals in standing practice or helping them move short distances safely. The handles adjust in height, and users can even rest or stabilise themselves using the device throughout the day. Can be used independently – The RAYMEX ® Lift allows many older adults to self-recover after a fall, without waiting for assistance. Instead of building it around the person, the individual transfers themselves onto the seat – usually by shuffling backwards – before activating the lift. For those with very limited mobility, a caregiver can still assist as needed. High battery capacity – The RAYMEX ® Lift delivers approximately 33 lifts per charge, which is ample for home use, especially given its multifunctionality.

Whether you’re navigating daily routines or heading out for an adventure, the Drive AeroMg offers freedom, comfort and ultra-light handling. Extremely lightweight with a carry weight of just 5.7kg Includes attendant brakes for added safety Dual cross brace design provides solid support and stability All round comfort with padded cushioning on seat and back Made with premium material including ultra lightweight magnesium-alloy frame

detail.description: An airline compliant 10Ah lithium battery, compatible with the Robooter X40 electric wheelchair. Travel with peace of mind! 7 miles maximum range.

The Sterling S800 by Scoozy effortlessly transitions you from biking to a mobility scooter, with fimiliar bike-style handlebar controls, 4 large wheels, advanced suspension, and a lithium battery. Engineered for stability and comfort on both urban streets and nature trails, the S800 delivers a modern and cool mobility solution. Bike-style handlebar controls Navigate effortlessly with the familiar bike-style handlebar, featuring a thumb throttle, handbrake, and an e-bike full color liquid retina LCD display. The intuitive controls, including cruise control, allow for smooth acceleration and braking, ensuring full control at all times. Additionally, the integrated NFC tag locking technology enhances security while providing a modern user experience. Spacious design with lithium battery The S800 comes standard with a lithium battery offering a 50 km range. The built-in battery heating enables the S800 to be used in freezing temperatures. Smartly positioned underneath the footplate, the design provides extra legroom and ensures an optimal ergonomic seating position. The display shows the remaining battery capacity, so you can ride longer without worrying about recharging. 4 large 18-inch wheels with advanced suspension The four large 18-inch wheels with striking rims not only add style but also enhance stability and comfort on any type of road. Their size helps absorb shocks, providing a smoother ride over bumps and uneven surfaces, whether cruising through the city or exploring nature trails. The trail tyres offer superior grip on muddy and slippery surfaces. Combined with a advanced suspension system, these features ensure a smooth and comfortable ride on all types of roads. Book a demo and test drive at: Felgains 33 Knightsdale Road Ipswich , Suffolk IP1 4JJ Phone: 01473 741144 Email: mail@felgains.com

Zenit The Zenit is a folding wheelchair but impresses with the look and handling of a rigid frame wheelchair. The patented Easy-Go folding system makes it easy to unfold. When combined with the foldable backrest, this clever folding mechanism ensures a compact and transportable wheelchair. Zenit CLT In addition to its innovative folding system, the Zenit CLT has firmly welded components which enhances driving stability. Key elements such as the centre of gravity, backrest, front wheel connections, brake mounts, and side part fittings are all securely welded, ensuring a stable and reliable performance. Zenit R The Zenit R is the perfect choice if you’re looking for a rigid frame wheelchair. This active wheelchair stands out for it’s lightweight design and rigid frame, ensuring every movement is translated directly into motion for an exceptional driving experience. With numerous adjustment options, the Zenit R can be perfectly tailored for maximum comfort. Zenit R CLT The Zenit R rigid frame wheelchair in the CLT version offers even more stability with its rigid frame and welded components. As with the Zenit CLT, the centre of gravity, back and front wheel connection as well as the brake connection and side panel mount are firmly welded, which enables maximum stability and efficiency when driving. Choose between aluminium or premium carbon frames in a range of Ottobock colours, including durable anodised finishes. Personalise further with vibrant colour accents from the Style Package. Front wheel and drive wheel adapters allow millimetre-perfect customisation of the centre of gravity and seat height for optimal comfort and control. The patented Easy-Go folding system ensures effortless folding and unfolding. Paired with a folding backrest, Zenit wheelchairs become easy to transport and store.

detail.description: Enjoy seamless mobility with the XSTO M4 Intelligent Power Wheelchair. Engineered for ease and performance, this lightweight electric wheelchair offers an impressive range of up to 17km on a single 4-hour charge, powered by a 25.55V 15.6Ah lithium battery. Designed for versatility, the XSTO M4 features one-touch folding for simple transport and adjustable height settings for personalised comfort. Its self-adjusting technology and high performance omniwheels ensure a smooth, stable ride on pavements, rough paths, and uneven surfaces. Whether commuting, travelling, or exploring, the XSTO M4 offers the perfect blend of reliability and flexibility for a more independent lifestyle. One touch folding Call function via XSTO app Adjustable height elevation Folds and dismantles for ease of transport Omniwheels for enhanced manoeuvrability, compact turning circles and stability on uneven terrain Auto-adjusts seat postion for step or gradient ascent

detail.description: The Rehasense ICON 60 manual wheelchair is available in several pre-set configurations and stocked sizes, and is one of the most adjustable wheelchairs currently available. This latest addition to the Rehasense portfolio which features a lightweight rigid 7000 Series Aluminium Alloy frame and carbon fibre side panels has been designed to enable the user to adjust various elements of the chair to suit their individual needs. The frame length and seat angle are adjustable and for maximum comfort, the backrest – which is foldable to assist with transporting the ICON 60 by car can be adjusted forward by up to 20˚ or backwards by up to 10˚. The seat height can also be easily adjusted with a choice of different heights which in turn changes the centre of gravity to make the chair a more ‘active’ model. As with all Rehasense products, the ICON 60 has been designed to be stylish, user friendly and aesthetically pleasing. With a maximum user capacity of 120kg and a choice of 4 colour finishes and several wheel, tyre and push rim options available, the ICON 60 takes manual wheelchair design to the next level.

Its sturdy attachment points make it simple to fit or remove the bag in seconds, offering both functionality and flexibility for daily use. The Otolift Modul-Air Smart Stairlift is exceptionally suitable for almost all types of staircase, whether it’s a staircase with one or multiple curves, or a spiral or helical staircase. In most cases, your handrail can remain intact, and your staircase will remain safely walkable. Thanks to the thinnest single rail in the world and our Reverse Drive Technology, this elegant stairlift can even be installed on very narrow staircases. Installation is possible on staircases as narrow as 70 centimeters. Since every situation is different, installing a stairlift is always a custom process. However, thanks to the modular design of the Otolift Modul-Air Smart, the concept of customization has been redefined. The stairlift’s rail is composed of innovative modules, enabling us to quickly and efficiently tailor the Modul-Air Smart to your specific staircase. The Otolift Modul-Air Smart is ideal for installation on the inside of your staircase. This placement ensures that the stairlift takes up minimal space, and in most cases, your handrail can remain intact. The armrests, seat, and footrest are easy and light to fold away. Thanks to the smart Reverse Drive Technology, the chair can move partially or fully backward, ensuring your knees never hit the wall, even on very narrow staircases. Compact, comfortable and stylish design Discreet single rail placed low on the staircase Suitable for steep and narrow stairs, offering maximum knee space Minimal footprint, leaving ample space for other users Battery-powered for continued operation during power outages Lightweight, easy-to-use controls Safety system that stops the lift automatically if obstacles are detected

It’s the ultimate combination, making it a practical everyday wheelchair and the perfect, small and compact travel companion. Available with a choice of hydroformed aluminium fixed front frames, the Champion is also available with the SK (Swiss Knife) front frame, which folds to the size of a backpack creating the smallest and most compact wheelchair on the market. Folding system: Easy folding is at the heart of the Küschall Champion, the perfectly engineered mechanism allows effortless folding of the frame and backrest in one easy motion, it’s also key to delivering the rigidity and superior driving performance to the Champion. Distinctive Footplate: Fully attached to the front frame and spring loaded to assist with the effortless folding of the Champion. When unfolded, the weight of the feet locks the footplate in place for a strong and rigid connection, the result is an unrivalled rigidity and driving performance in a folding wheelchair. Compact & Transportable: Küschall Champion offers a fully folding backrest option which locks in place when folded, convenient when lifting and transporting. Fully Adjustable: As well as being compact, practical and highly configurable, the Küschall Champion is fully adjustable. Offering easy and robust adjustment possibilities to all the key areas of the wheelchair ensures the perfect level of support, for comfort that lasts. Enhanced Comfort: Küschall Champion offers an extensive selection of options and accessories to support a wide variety of comfort needs and personalities. Ready to Travel: Both Champion models are available with travel bags. The fixed frame option can be transported with the wheels on. The SK version can be folded small enough to fit into the purpose-built, fully padded backpack with useful compartments for

The unique design of the cross brace allows for effortless folding combined with built-in rigidity, making it energy efficient and light to propel, comparable to that of a rigid frame wheelchair. detail.description: The Invacare Comet Pro is your perfect mobility scooter for taking trips into town, popping to the local shops, and going on day long trips. Anywhere you want to go; the Invacare Comet Pro is designed with outstanding features to take you there in comfort, safety, and style. Comet Pro is made with powerful outdoor capabilities, combined with advanced safety features and options; this ensures a quick, robust, and reliable drive. Comet Pro features exceptional driving features and modern aesthetics to deliver premium performance and control. The 2 x 75 Ah batteries allow users to enjoy challenging journeys beyond the city’s limits. It also has a large 13” front and rear wheels, combined with a superior suspension system that allows safe negotiation of kerbs and obstacles smoothly and comfortably. More so, the automatic speed reduction will slow you down when driving around corners at high speed for additional stability and safety. The Invacare Comet Pro mobility scooter gives ultimate confidence and reassurance when driving the electric scooter. More advanced safety features, such as a two-step disengaging lever and automatic speed reduction, offers additional peace of mind wherever you go. Advanced suspension: This ensures a smooth and comfortable drive over uneven terrain. Easy drive direction stability: This feature keeps you in a straight line at high speeds for additional safety and stability. detail.description: The Karma Blazer is a compact powerchair, making it great for indoor use and manoeuvring in tight spaces. Powerful motors, large front castors and rear suspension make it capable outdoors. It is available in a choice of seats, either an adjustable sling or a comfortable captain seat. The backrest can be folded easily folded flat onto the seat for transport or storage. Excellent Indoor Maneuverability The Blazer’s total width is from just 580 mm, making it one of the most compact power chairs on the market. It is smooth and easy to navigate through doorways, into lifts, or around confined spaces. Great Outdoor Performance Blazer’s excellent performance extends outdoors; independent rear wheel suspension and oversized 9-inch front castors ensure a smooth ride, while an optional LED lighting system adds safety for on-road use. Captain or Sling Seat Blazer Sling not only offers 3 seat width options, it also provides 8° to 28° degree power tilt, which allows the users to easily change their position, thus shifting the pressure away from the hipbones and redistributing it over a larger surface area. The new Blazer Captain Seat (KP-31.2 CPT) offers the ability to manually recline the backrest from 0°-56° or 0°-47°. This allows the user to stretch their hip joints and relax their back muscles. Easy Transfer The flip-back armrests and swing-away footrests make it easy to transfer to and from the seat or move closer to a table. Adjustable The seat depth, back angle, headrest height, headrest angle, armrest height, armpad position, and footrest depth are all adjustable.

The Quantum 4Front2 Electric Wheelchair is a front-wheel drive powerchair that features Smart Traction Control (STC), along with Smooth Ride Suspension (SRS), this provides stability for smooth obstacle transitions and unmatched driving performance. Additional new features include 4-pole motors and redesigned castor arms for improved durability and aesthetics and reduced weight. SRS provides a smooth comfortable ride and advanced stability. products.name: Alber e-fix E35/E36 Wheelchair Power Assist

detail.description: With the Alber e-fix E35/E36 Wheelchair Power Assist, you can turn your manual wheelchair into a compact electric wheelchair! The drive can be individually programmed and can therefore be adapted perfectly to your personal needs. The electric add-on drive is the simple way to increase your freedom of movement. The e-fix also allows you to cover greater distances and handle slopes effortlessly. The Alber e-fx components are lightweight and compact, and can be quickly removed from the wheelchair without the need for tools. The speed can be set up to 4mph using the easy-grip controller. As a rule, the slower you drive, the swifter the wheelchair reacts. You steer, the e-fix responds! If the situation requires it, the e-fix can also be easily moved by hand: You uncouple the drive wheels with a handle and your wheelchair can be pushed by hand as usual – either using the push rims or by an attendant. The manual wheels can usually still be used too. Gain extra features with the optional Mobility Plus Package including the easyNavi wheelchair route finder, remote control and speed upgrade to 5mph.

products.name: Alber Via Go Wheelchair Power Pack

detail.description: The Alber Via Go Wheelchair Power Pack is a high quality, user-friendly power assist designed to fit most rigid and folding manual wheelchairs. Compact and convenient – its lightweight design and compact dimensions makes this unit very easy to handle and ideal for day-to-day tasks and excursions. It can be removed quickly if required and stowed away to save space. Strong and enduring – even on inclines, ramps and uneven surfaces. the via GO provides the right amount of power assistance just when you need it. Simply press the plus or minus symbol on the control to adjust the speed. Intuitive and flexible – the via GO is so straightforward you can use it immediately. Its large buttons with make control a breeze. With via GO the unit doesn’t need to be removed when folding the wheelchair. It has a range of up to 10 miles, depending on the terrain, and can power up slopes up to 16% gradient with a max speed of 3.4mph. The control unit simply attaches to the push handles of the chair and can be mounted either left or right depending on your preference. The power assist unit neatly attaches via a bracket underneath the wheelchair. Charging the unit is easy and straightforward.

detail.description: The Opera Mallow Adjustable Mattress offers exceptional value, combining 1000 pocket springs with layers of natural wool and cotton for superior comfort. The firm design provides optimal support and easy manoeuvrability for all users. The TurnAid Patient Turning System enables careful in-bed repositioning and turning of clients at the touch of a button. The patient turning system enables nursing staff to reposition and turn the patient in a gentle and dignified manner, using a hands-off approach. In addition, the TurnAid reduces strain on the back for nursing staff and family members during the repositioning of patients weighing up to 350kg. Excessive spinal loading and resultant back pain are significantly minimised. The TurnAid system is easy to install on almost all community-style profiling beds, using appropriate adaptors where necessary. The basic functions of the bed are retained, and the system can be used together with pressure-relieving mattresses for rapid treatment of pressure damage. With the TurnAid, mobilising in and out of bed is much easier for clients, thanks to the solid bars at the sides of the mattress. Here is an overview of the TurnAid’s functions: To find out how the TurnAid patient turning system could help your organisation save money on care packages whilst improving dignity and quality in care, please call us or request a free trial here . Please note: The TurnAid system is only compatible with TurnAid slide sheets and turn sheets. Use of other sheets may invalidate the warranty and may constitute a risk to user safety. Please speak to us for further details. Please note: We supply the TurnAid System in the UK only. For enquiries outside the UK, please contact the manufacturer directly.

Maintain safe patient handling and dignity in the care of children after death. We talk a great deal about safety and dignity in patient handling, and w e should never abandon this when a patient pass es away. The message NHS Trusts gave us was that mortuary transfer trolleys are no longer fit for purpose. So we acted. T he new Stride Paediatric Concealment Trolley enables 21st-century care after death, with a modern design that prioritises the dignity of patients and families. With smaller dimensions than the Stride Concealment Trolley , this trolley has been purpose-built for paediatric transfers. Strong but lightweight construction means this concealment trolley is built for the r igour of portering services, both indoors and outdoors. The stability of the trolley allows for much smoother and more dignified transport of deceased patients. The collapsible frame and flush-fold side rails allow for easy patient transfers from the hospital bed onto the concealment trolley. T he smooth surfaces of the platform, frame and vinyl cover are all easy to clean – essential for infection control and prevention. Replacement standard and custom-printed covers are available. detail.description: The Karma VIP2 Tilting & Reclining Wheelchair allows wheelchair users with weak trunk control to travel like everyone else. The tilt-in-space and reclining function provide the optimal pressure relief and positioning settings. And thanks to its foldable and lightweight design, it’s also car transportable. Tilt-in-Space : Allows the wheelchair user to change position throughout the day, which will redistribute and relieves pressure. This feature helps reduce the risk of developing pressure ulcer and prevent discomfort associated with prolonged sitting. The weight shifting system provides a steady smooth recline and a sense of security for the user when reclining. Anti-Sliding Reclining System : Solves the problem of sliding by locating the reclining pivot point of the chair and bringing the user’s hip joint closer to it. This placement synchronises the motion of the body and the chair and minimizes the sliding and the shearing when reclining or sitting upright. Adjustable and Detachable Armrests : Adjust the height of the armrests, with no tools required. Easily removable for transfers and transport. Detachable Swing-away Footrest : Allows for easy transfer, on and off the wheelchair and detaches with no tools required. Tension Adjustable Backrest : Use the adjustable Velcro straps to change the tension and conform according to the wheelchair user. This helps to prevent slouching and the hammock effect. Clean, Comfortable, and Fresh : the removable upholstery is anti-microbial, breathable and washable. Crash Tested : The VIP2 is approved for transportation in accordance with ISO 7176-19. This means it is suitable to be used as a seat in a motor vehicle for transport.

detail.description: The Karma MVP 502 Reclining Wheelchair allows the wheelchair user to lie back and relieve pressure, while reducing the risk of sliding. With thick padded cushioning and an ergonomic headrest, it’s an ideal option for long term care users – and thanks to a foldable frame and backrest, it’s also car transportable. You can also choose between transit wheelchair or self-propelled wheelchair versions. Articulating Legrests : Extends in length as they elevate, allowing the leg to extend freely and easing pressure on the knees. Anti-sliding V-Shape Seat : Slopes downwards at a 20 degree angle near the backrest to help reduce forward sliding and pressure sores. This significantly reduces shearing, and the need for the attendant to reposition the user. Hydraulic Pressure Support System : Two hydraulic gas springs provide a smooth, controlled reclining motion and make it easy for the attendant to lift the wheelchair user back to an upright position. Foldable Push Bar : Makes it easy to push the wheelchair with just one hand, and at the same time reinforces the structure of the wheelchair. There is no need to detach because it folds with the wheelchair for storage and transport. Adjustable Flip-Up Armrests: Pivotally connected to the backrest, they follow the natural movement of the arms when the backrest reclines. You can adjust the height of the armrests, with no tools required. The armrests also flip-up for easier transfers in and out of the wheelchair. Tension Adjustable Backrest and Seat : Use the adjustable Velcro straps to change the tension and conform according to the wheelchair user. This helps to prevent slouching and the hammock effect. Clean, Comfortable, and Fresh : the removable upholstery is anti-microbial, breathable and washable. Crash Tested : The MVP 502 is approved for transportation in accordance with ISO 7176-19. This means it is suitable to be used as a seat in a motor vehicle for transport.

detail.description: The NRS Walk Safe® is a revolutionary lightweight indoor walking frame with a brand-new design that’s proven to be twice as stable when turning, compared to the traditional zimmer frame. Created in partnership with the University of Salford and backed by four years of academic research and development, the Walk Safe® is a game-changer, truly breaking free of the walking frame mould which has barely changed in 70 years. Easy and safe turning The incredible new castor design on the Walk Safe® lets you turn as you walk, without having to lift the whole frame up. You get smoother, more stable turns and a more natural walking movement. With Magnetic Directional Bias, the wheels return to a forward-facing position once you’ve made your turn, giving you much more control when you travel in a straight line. Combined rear pressure brake and glide A combined glide and brake on the rear legs gives you a smooth motion and controlled stopping all in one handy feature. The glide travels smoothly over your home’s surfaces and thresholds, rather than the jerky movement of a traditional rear ferrule. However, if you apply pressure to the frame, the rear brake contacts the floor to bring you to a safe stop. Built-in lower handles This newest zimmer frame on the market also has two lower handles, cleverly designed to give you extra support when you stand up from your chair, sofa, or bed – as well as when you sit back down again. They’re particularly useful if your chair doesn’t have armrests, or if you’re getting up from a bed or sofa. Positioned so that the Walk Safe® won’t tip when you use them correctly to stand or sit, these lower handles are at a much easier height to aid you from a sitting position. More great features: Available in two sizes – each height and width adjustable Large 125mm wheels Lightweight, fully welded frame Cushioned upper handles Heavy duty max. user weight of 230kg (36 stone) Compatible with the Buckingham Caddy 2-year guarantee

products.name: Lead Skirts for ImageFlow Fluoroscopy Stretcher

detail.description: Removable lead skirts for the ImageFlow Imaging & Fluoroscopy Stretcher . IR(ME)R (Ionising Radiation (Medical Exposure) Regulations) is UK legislation that ensures ionising radiation (e.g. X-rays and fluoroscopy) is used only when justified, optimised and kept as low as reasonably practicable (ALARP) , while still achieving the required clinical outcome. It also places legal responsibilities on employers and duty holders to protect patients, staff and others from unnecessary radiation exposure. How our lead skirts support NHS Trusts: Reduce scatter radiation exposure to staff during fluoroscopy and interventional procedures. Help Trusts meet their obligations to optimise radiation protection and maintain a safe working environment. Contribute to ALARP by providing effective shielding where engineering controls alone are not sufficient. Support staff safety, regulatory compliance and good radiation protection practice as part of a Trust’s overall IR(ME)R and IRR17 radiation safety programme.

detail.description: The Kingkraft Eclipse is a entry-level height adjustable bath for disabled persons offering discreet mobility support for assisted bathing needs. Using the hand-held remote control, the Eclipse moves up and down, ensuring that it is perfectly adjusted to the correct height to enable the user to step in, or be transferred in, via a ceiling track hoist. When the user is in position, the bath height can then be adjusted to enable a carer to assist; helping promote safe manual handling practice. This bath is an ideal choice for installation within a care setting where there may be multiple users. Alternatively, it would also be beneficial within a family home environment where it may be used by other family members. The Eclipse is designed and styled to look like a regular bath and not something you may expect from typical bathroom disability equipment. With a contemporary appearance, the Kingkraft Eclipse bath would compliment any modern setting. The functionality of the Eclipse can also be extended with Kingkraft bath cushions and supports, as well as spa options, including LED Sensory Lighting, Whirlpool Spa and Bluetooth Music System. Made in the UK, Kingkraft manufacture the Multibath to the highest quality and safety standards, with internal insulation and RADA anti-scald TMV3 thermostatic mixer taps supplied as standard. All care needs are supported in a robust but contemporary bath tub that fits in to a modern, homely environment. With safe clearance for hoist transfers, the recessed base also enables carers to position themselves as close as possible to the bather. And with electric height adjustment, the Multibath moves up and down at the touch of a button, ensuring the bath is set at the appropriate height for independent and hoisted transfers, and at a safe working height for carers. Taken together, these features support safe manual handling in the bathroom. The versatility of the Multibath extends further with optional additional functionality. It can be supplied with either a fixed or removable folding changing bench top, a safe and efficient solution for showering, drying and changing. The Multibath can also be complemented with Kingkraft bath cushions and supports to provide added comfort and postural support for bathers. A range of spa systems are available, including LED Sensory Lighting, Whirlpool Spa and Bluetooth Music System, adding sensory dynamics to make bathing an even more relaxing experience. All care needs are supported in a robust but contemporary bath tub that fits in to a modern, homely environment. Made in the UK, Kingkraft manufacture the Multibath to the highest quality and safety standards, with internal insulation and RADA anti-scald TMV3 thermostatic mixer taps supplied as standard. Kingkraft offer a 2 Year Guarantee as standard, with optional Gold, Silver & Bronze Warranty & Service Packages for added peace of mind into the future.

The Neptune bath lift has an compact design with a fixed back, which maximises legroom in the bath and combines with a low seat height to allow good immersion in the bath. It blends discreetly into your bathroom and is compact and light enough to easily carry and store. Despite its light weight, it offers a maximum user weight of 25 stone. Suitable for most types of bath and simply sits in your bathtub, securely attached with four suction feet. A slimline hand control with large rocker switches makes operating the bath chair easy even if you have limited dexterity. Safely use the Neptune without electricity in the bathroom. The Neptune bath lift is powered by a fully waterproof, rechargeable battery hand control. The battery will indicate when it needs recharging and its Stop Descent feature stops the bath lift lowering you into your bath if the battery is too low. Easily remove the Netpune from your bath at any time to take away or free up bath space for other users. Its simple design with smooth surfaces makes it easy to clean and gives good access for cleaning your bathtub as usual.

products.name: Alber E-Motion M25 Wheelchair Power Assist Wheels

detail.description: Alber’s e-motion M25 power assist wheels can fit onto almost any wheelchair and allow you to move, steer and brake your chair with very little effort. With a support speed of up to 5.2mph and a range of 15 miles, you can reach your destination with ease. Whether it’s longer distances, slopes or carrying a few more kilos in luggage, e-motion can keep you moving while protecting muscles and joints from overwork. Key Features & Benefits Sensors built into e-motion’s push-rims activate the motors as you initiate pushing, measuring your drive movement and providing you with tailored power assistance. The sensitivity can be adjusted and there’s a range of rim styles to suit your needs. The optional ECS remote control enables you to choose assistance levels for indoor and outdoor use and activates a clever hill holder function that prevents your wheelchair rolling on slopes. E-motion’s Mobility App offers a range of driving profiles and allows you to enable the maximum speed of 5.2mph. You can also activate cruise control, an innovative function that maintains a set speed on a single push of the handrims. The e-motion drive wheels are available in 22, 24 and 25 inch diameters and can be easily attached and detached from your wheelchair without the need for tools. Lightweight and compact, you can take e-motion power assist everywhere you go. Book a demo and test drive at: Felgains 33 Knightsdale Road Ipswich , Suffolk IP1 4JJ Phone: 01473 741144 Email: mail@felgains.com

detail.description: The Alber Smoov is a power assist drive unit for active wheelchairs, adding a new level of mobility to your chair by converting it to a power chair with a top speed of 10 km/h. Highly durable and functional, it can be fitted to most folding and rigid wheelchairs and offers consistently high performance, with a 360° swivel drive wheel which maintains speed and manoeuvrability even on uneven terrain. Key Features & Benefits Easy docking and undocking : easily mount or remove your Smoov power assist at any time with the carrying handle that can be accessed while your seated in your wheelchair. Combined with its lightweight construction, this makes it a breeze to transport. Effortless control : enjoy on-demand power with the Bluetooth hand control unit, which can be mounted either side of your chair. Just spin to adjust speed and tap to turn off, keeping track of battery life on the display. Go hands free as you choose. Dynamic power : rely on high performance across a wide variety of even and uneven surfaces – think carpet, grass, gravel – and power up hills and slopes of up to 16%. You can even safely ride tilted over kerbs with the Smoov’s flexible wheel and 360 degree swivel fork. Everyday convenience : it’s even equipped with a handy USB socket, so you can charge your phone on the go. And adjust and extend the power drive’s functions with the SMOOV Mobility App. Book a demo and test drive at: Felgains 33 Knightsdale Road Ipswich IP1 4JJ United Kingdom (UK) Phone: 01473 741144 Email: mail@felgains.com

products.name: Alber V12 Viaplus Wheelchair Power Pack

detail.description: The Alber Viaplus V12 is a power pack which fits the Invacare Azalea and Clematis comfort wheelchairs, relieving carers from the effort of manually pushing the chair. You can simply engage and disengage the drive wheels at the touch of a button, and you’re ready to go. With automatic braking and an intelligent spring system which compensates for bumps and uneven terrain, you’re assured of a safe and comfortable ride. Key Features & Benefits The V12 powerpack can be dismantled without tools for easy storage or transport, or it can be left on the wheelchair without restricting use of any functions, including tilt-in-space All functions are clearly marked on a handy, non-slip grip control knob that can be operated with just one hand – for easiest possible use from the word go. The rechargeable battery of the viaplus is mounted inconspicuously below the seat of the wheelchair and is powerful enough for even long walks. It can be quickly and easily recharged using the battery charger supplied with it

products.name: Alerta Folding Bedside Crash Mat with Wireless Alert

detail.description: The Alertamat Crash Mat with Wireless Nurse Call Alert is designed to be placed next to the bed to minimise injury if the user should fall from bed and activates the nurse call system when a fall occurs. This helps prevent a user remaining on the mat undetected for an unknown length of time after falling, by alerting the caregiver to provide timely assistance. A wireless connect-and-play system, the mat incorporates sensor pads and a Wireless Transmitter within the foam which connects to the Alerta Wall Point Receiver (sold separately). It can be connected to a nurse call system for centralised activation, or used on its own, independent of a nurse call system to give localised alerts through the Alerta Wall Point Receiver only. The volume can be deactivated for silent in-room operation when connected to a nurse call system. The Alertamat Crash Mat is quick and easy to position and benefits from a PU wipe clean surface. When unfolded the mat is 180cm long x 60cm wide x 6cm high. The mat folds in half for easy storage and transportation.

The Robooter E40 Powerchair is a sleek, foldable indoor electric wheelchair that seamlessly combines performance, portability, and style. Designed for easy daily use with comfortable leg space and a small turning radius, it is powered by a robust 20AH lithium-ion battery, covering an impressive 14.3 miles on a single charge. With smooth maneuverability on various floor surfaces, its lightweight design makes it ideal for transportation in cars, airplanes, and more. Perfect for tight spaces, the E40 features a small turning radius of just 450mm (17in), making it ideal for elevators and navigating through compact areas in offices, apartments or bedrooms. With remote control capability, you can take command of your wheelchair from the palm of your hand! Control it remotely using your phone, adding a new level of convenience to your mobility experience. You can also benefit from easy transfers on and off the Robooter E40 powerchair, with flip-up armrests and a flip-up footrest. The Invacare Action Ampla Bariatric Wheelchair is a multi-award winning self-propelled wheelchair especially designed to cater for the needs of bariatric or plus sized individuals, taking into consideration varying body shapes and activity levels. With a durable but lightweight rigid aluminium frame and an active rear wheel position for easier access to the handrims, the Ampla’s clever design enables a more natural position of the upper body allowing optimal energy transfer during propulsion. Inbuilt trolley mode The Ampla wheelchair can also negotiate doorways and passageways effortlessly in most environments with an optional smart transportation system to the rear of the frame. In three simple steps you can stand to tilt the wheelchair onto the transportation system and roll the complete chair on its rear through doorways. Key features Unique backrest design: ensuring free movement of the upper limbs when propelling. The innovative backrest also adjusts to allow for a perfect fit for both plus-size male and female users. Multi-functional transfer levers: support standing transfers, offers a resting position for the forearm and can be adjusted in height giving access up to and under tables or desks. Sleek and minimalist: with its modern appearance, the Ampla wheelchair provides independence and support for a comfortable and active lifestyle. Award winning: Invacare Action Ampla has won a Red Dot Award for Product Design. This award is not only the largest product competition in the world, but also one of the most prestigious design awards. The Action Ampla wheelchair has also won the Italian Platinum A’Design Award and the Gold German Design Award.

detail.description: The Kuschall KSL 2.0 Rigid Active Wheelchair is the lightest and most iconic award-winning Küschall wheelchair designed for experienced users who know their preferred setup. From a super lightweight rigid design built with powerful geometry, to a precise fit with even more options, the KSL delivers tailored performance for you. The new hydroformed frame brings a unique and modern styling to the KSL wheelchair. Additionally, the frame profile provides increased rigidity and ergonomic grip to support comfortable repositioning and transfers. Super Lightweight The Kuschall KSL wheelchair is one of the lightest wheelchairs on the market, with a transport weight starting at just 4.3 kg! This makes it more than 15% lighter than the adjustable Kuschall K-Series. Centre of Gravity The KSL with COG (Centre of Gravity) is a new dynamic option giving you more adjustment. Simply choose the right wheel position for you at anytime. Fully Welded The KSL with FW (Fully Welded) gives even better agility and performance in the chair. This option is a complete box frame from the front to the back and features a built-in grab bar for even easier handling. The Alerta MoveAssist Standing & Transfer Aid is a transfer assist unit which makes transfer functions of all types quick and easy, requiring minimal caregiver assistance. The Alerta MoveAssist promotes user engagement and enhances mobility. Each unit is equipped with a crossbar which users can grasp and pull themself up into a standing position using their own strength. The padded split seats swing out allowing the user to stand up and board the unit. The caregiver then flips the split seats back into place to form a secure and comfortable seat for the user to sit on for the remainder of the transfer. A user who qualifies to use the Alerta MoveAssist Standing & Transfer Aid must have enough leg and lower body strength to stand up and remain in the standing/sitting position. Adequate arm strength is required if the user must use the crossbar. Users who satisfy these criteria and have difficulty walking or present a potential for falling down will find the Alerta MoveAssist a useful and safe transfer device. For users who lack these requirements, a stand aid hoist is recommended. Choose from four standard fabrics for express delivery or have your chair made to order with your choice of fabric Choose Light Oak frame for quick delivery or select from natural, teak and mahogany on made to order Button back design provides excellent head and neck support Extended wooden arms for easy grip when standing Solid wood frame for strength and stability High quality, British made fireside chair for long-lasting comfort and support

detail.description: The Alerta Wireless Floor+ Alertamat is a long-life alert mat with hygiene and ease of use in mind. The light colour is ideal for dementia users who may otherwise try and avoid the mat. The large size also avoids the chance of overstepping the mat. Best placed by the bedside or in a doorway, the Floor Alertamat alerts the carer whenever a service user leaves their safe zone. The volume can be deactivated for silent in-room operation when connected to a nurse call system. No wires means this mat is more versatile and easier to use.

The Wireless Deluxe Alertamat is a robust alert mat, topped with genuine carpet and available in 5 colours meaning it can fit in with any room. This is especially Dementia friendly as it helps prevent users avoiding the mat. The large size also avoids the chance of overstepping the mat. It is well built, with long lasting welded seals and strong wiring. Most effective by a bed or in a doorway, it alerts the caregiver when the user leaves the safe zone. The volume can be deactivated for silent in-room operation when connected to a nurse call system. Available in: Beige, Grey, Rust, Blue or Red Dimensions: 600 x 900 mm / 23.5 x 35.5 inches

The Wireless Chair Alertamat allows a caregiver to monitor if the user is at risk without having to be right in the room all the time Best when concealed under the chair cushion for dignity and to avoid pressure damage risk, the Chair Alertamat automatically resets when the user sits back down on the chair. Dimensions: 250 x 380 mm / 10 x 15 inches

The Wireless Bed Alertamat allows the caregiver to monitor if the user is at risk without having to be right in the room all the time Best when concealed under the mattress for dignity and to avoid pressure damage risk. Automatically resets when the user gets back into bed. Dimensions: 250 x 760 mm / 10 x 30 inches

products.name: Alerta Wireless Alert Nurse Call Button

detail.description: The Alerta Wireless Alert Nurse Call Button gives you peace of mind you can call for help at any time. This wireless personal call button connects to a nurse call system via the Alerta Wall Point Receiver . It comes with a lanyard, and a holder that can be wall mounted. You can easily adjust volume between high, low and silent. It can be mains or battery powered – if using batteries, it requires 1x 12v 23A battery (supplied with product). The Wall Point Receiver can also be either mains or battery powered (1 x 12v 23a supplied). No cables, extra safe and versatile 95m wireless range from transmitter to receiver Low battery alert Please note: the user will need to be assessed for lanyard suitability – due to a potential risk of asphyxiation or restriction to blood flow.
features: No cables, extra safe and versatile
95m wireless range from transmitter to receiver

detail.description: The E-Goes Joyrider Folding Electric Wheelchair is an ultra lightweight, compact, foldable and transportable powerchair. It has a minimalist design, folds easily and separates into two parts in a matter of seconds. Before folding, the Joyrider’s motor unit can be removed, keeping the heaviest part just 8.6kg! This makes it much easier to lift into and out of the car boot. The Joyrider Powerchair offers superb manoeuvrability in tight spaces, with the ability to turn on its own axis, and the ergonomic joystick gives you full control over direction and speed. Two brushless electric motors which provide a total of 400 watts which is enough to power the Joyrider up to 10 degree inclines with ease. An electromagnetic braking system ensures that the powerchair stops as soon as the joystick is released, preventing you from rolling forwards or backwards. Anti-tip wheels mounted to the rear give added reassurance on inclines and PU solid tyres both front and rear avoid punctures while out and about. Airline approved batteries make the Joyrider Electric Wheelchair an ideal travel companion and charging is made easy with on-board and off-board options, with a total charging time of 4.5-5.5 hours. Another great feature is the swinging footrest which allows you to get nice and close to the chair before sitting down, making transferring on and off the powerchair much easier!

The Quantum Edge 3 Stretto Electric Wheelchair is a mid-wheel drive powerchair that features an ultra-narrow base width for outstanding manoeuvrability, as well as SRS (Smooth Ride Suspension), making it the perfect indoor/outdoor electric wheelchair. An ultra-narrow base width of just 52cm combined with mid-wheel drive allows the Quantum Edge 3 Stretto Electric Wheelchair to turn on the spot for superb manoeuvrability indoors. Its performance outdoors is also impressive, with optional 6 mph motors and long-range 62 Ah batteries. • SRS (Smooth Ride Suspension) is a superior automotive-grade electric wheelchair power suspension developed after two years of research and consumer feedback. SRS provides a smooth comfortable ride and advanced stability. • LED lights come as standard, mounted to the fender above the drive tyres on each side, ensuring that you can see and be seen. • Choose from a range of control options, from the standard NE+ system to the Q-Logic 3 Advanced Drive Control System, an adaptable control system that includes wireless Bluetooth programming and device access, in-built USB charger and attendant control options. Contoured Seating • A basic Captain’s seating system available in a limited range of sizes, a simple option where special positioning isn’t needed. It features adjustable seat depth, height adjustable arms and a reclining back which folds flat, making it perfect for car boot hoisting. TB Flex Seating • TB Flex is an entry-level prescriptive seating system which is fully adjustable to suit your needs. It provides up to 30° of tilt, 254 mm (10 inches) of lift, can recline 95°-125°, and can tilt/recline up to 125°. TRU-Balance® 3 Power Positioning System • TRU-Balance® 3 Power Positioning System features quick adjustment with minimum fuss. An innovative design that maximises functional independence while providing an appealing look and feel. iLevel® seat lift is the stand-out feature on this seating system, allowing you to drive at 3.5 mph w

The Ottobock Juvo B4 Electric Wheelchair is a compact but super robust and durable powerchair for reliable everyday use. A rear-wheel drive powerchair, the B4 offers enhanced safety and comfortable damping characteristics for outdoor use. It is also compact and manoeuvrable indoors. Permanent drive wheel suspension compensates for uneven surfaces and the electric wheelchair’s small outside dimension makes it easier to drive through narrow doorways and navigate in confined spaces. Like all models in the Juvo product line, the B4 features a modular design and offers a high level of flexibility. The B4’s rear-wheel drive base is robust, durable and requires little maintenance. Driving through narrow doorways and navigating in confined spaces is made easier by a total width of just 59 cm. Smaller wheel sizes are available for indoor use. Permanent drive wheel suspension compensates for uneven surfaces and ensures enhanced safety and comfortable damping. This can be further optimised with an additional front suspension. Integrated anti-tipper rollers ensure enhanced safety and protect against damage when driving backward. External power supply sockets are a new feature on the Ottobock Juvo B4 Electric Wheelchair: 12 V, 24 V and a USB charging receptacle with two inputs. This means you can charge your mobile phone when you’re out and about. Choose your seating The Standard seating package comes in four sizes with an adaptable seat width and seat depth. It has a folding backrest tension adjustable back upholstery, flip-up armrests and choice of three leg support styles. The Vario Adjust Seat (VAS) is highly adjustable to precisely match your body measurements even if your needs change. The Ergo-Joint back angle adjustment largely eliminates shear forces. The seat frame holds a variety of mounting options including lateral supports. The Baxx Line ergonomic rigid backrests can be combined with VAS.
