detail.description: Your Personal Data and ProKnow May 24, 2018 3 minute read If you use online services as much as we do here at ProKnow, you’ve probably been bombarded with several emails this month from those companies. That’s because, on May 25, 2018, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) will go into effect. The GDPR imposes new rules for companies that process EU citizens’ personal data and hefty maximum penalties for non-compliance. This month the companies that provide you with online services were making you aware of the updates they’ve made to comply with the GDPR and inform you of any change to their terms or privacy policies. We’ve also been hard at work to provide more transparency and control in regards to the way we process your personal data, not just because of the GDPR, but because it’s the right thing to do. We know your privacy is important to you, and it’s important to us, too. Here is a list of the improvements we’ve made in the way we communicate information about how we use your personal data and new features we’ve introduced to give you more control over your personal data on ProKnowSystems.com. Email Preferences. We’ve always given you the ability to unsubscribe from
features: Email Preferences. We’ve always given you the ability to unsubscribe from our marketing communications at the bottom of any of our marketing emails. Now, however, we’ve added the ability to change your preferences so that you only get the emails for the topics in which you’re interested. For example, if you’re only interested in plan study announcements and the monthly digest, you can check those and uncheck the others. You can still find the link to update your preferences at the bottom of our email communications.

Additional Information. Some personal information in your ProKnow profile is optional, like your mailing address, phone number, and AAMD information. We’ve improved the way we communicate which fields are required and which are optional. We’ve also made it easy to remove any optional information if you no longer wish to share it with us.

Privacy Policy. You also may have noticed that our Privacy Policy has changed. As part of these changes, we’ve included specific information about how we use your personal data and other GDPR-specific notices on things like data transfers outside of the country. You can find the full text here .

detail.description: DVH Calculation Accuracy A suite of test data and analysis software to validate your software’s DVH curves August 25, 2017 2 minute read Do you think your software’s DVH calculations are as accurate as they can be? Do you take these graphs and statistics for granted? Well, maybe you shouldn’t! (For background, view slides from a recent webinar we gave as part of the AAMD’s National Dosimetrist Week, 2017 .) Recently, ProKnow’s own Ben Nelms worked on a project with Vladimir Feygelman, Ph.D. and other colleagues at Moffitt Cancer Center, with the goal to design analytical datasets and analysis methods to validate the accuracy of DVH algorithms. These algorithms, contrary to popular belief, are not all created equal, nor are they always rigorously validated by the manufacturers of treatment planning systems (TPS) and other applicable software. In June 2015, the Medical Physics journal accepted our work for publication, a paper entitled: “ Methods, software and datasets to verify DVH calculations against analytical values: Twenty Years Late(r) .” The article was published in volume 42(8). products.name: How Are Contouring Accuracy Scores Calculated

detail.description: How are contouring accuracy "scores" calculated? August 12, 2016 3 minute read Method 1: StructSure Method (Most Sensitive) ProKnow uses the advanced “StructSure” method of scoring (US Patent 8,081,813) to generate the contour accuracy scores for the Contouring Accuracy Program. This patented method was first published in 2012 in the International Journal of Radiation Oncology Biology Physics (i.e. “Red Journal”). This method generates a score (0 to 100) for the accuracy of the user’s contour when compared to the “gold” or expert contour. It is a 3D algorithm that creates a volume from the user’s contours, a volume from the expert’s contours, and then goes through and finds all errant voxels and penalizes them. An errant voxel can be “missing” (user’s contour is too small, i.e. inside the expert’s contour) or “extra” (user’s contour is too large, i.e. outside the expert’s contour). If an errant voxel is within a “forgiveness region” (usually 1 mm) then there is no penalty. If an errant voxel is outside the forgiveness region, it gets a penalty assigned based on “how wrong it is” (i.e. based on the 3D distance error to find the closest surface of the expert’s contour). features: Elekta Unity Elekta Evo Frequently Asked Questions What is Adaptive Radiotherapy? Adaptive radiotherapy (also known as ART or Adaptive Radiation Therapy) adjusts treatment to each patient’s anatomy and tumor response. There are two main ways of adapting treatment plans: offline, where the plan is adapted in between sessions, or online, where the plan is adapted in between sessions, or online, where the plan is adapted immediately prior to treatment or during treatment whilst the patient remains on the treatment couch. How does online Adaptive Radiotherapy differ from traditional radiotherapy? Online adaptive radiotherapy is a treatment approach that adapts the radiation plan in real-time based on the patient’s anatomy at the time of treatment. Unlike traditional radiotherapy, which uses a static reference plan created before the first fraction, online adaptive radiotherapy uses onboard imaging (e.g. MRI or CBCT) to visualize the anatomy of the day and anatomical changes, such as tumor shrinkage or organ motion and adapt the plan accordingly. This ensures more precise targeting and better sparing of healthy tissue for more personalized treatments. What role does imaging play in enabling Adaptive Radiotherapy? Online adaptive radiotherapy demands high-quality daily imaging, whether via CBCT or MRI, to clearly visualize the target and organs at risk (OARs). This level of imaging is essential to assess daily anatomical changes and determine whether plan adaptation is necessary. Moreover, crisp, highly detailed imaging is required for AI-driven auto-segmentation to support consistent, reproducible adaptation and to enable fast workflows. In short, high-quality imaging isn’t just a component of online adaptive radiotherapy; it’s what makes it possible. How do CT and MR-Linacs complement each other in Radiation Therapy? The emergence of online adaptive therapy on CT-Linacs significantly broadens access to Adaptive radiotherapy (ART), making it feasible for more clinics and more patients. However, this does not replace the unique value of MRgRT, it complements it. This hybrid model mirrors the diagnostic imaging world, where clinicians choose the modality that best suits the clinical question. In the same way, radiation oncologists will select between CT and MR guidance based on tumor site, motion characteristics, and clinical goals. CT-guided ART is highly effective for many common indications, such as prostate, bladder, lung and pelvic lymph nodes, where anatomical structures are clearly visible on CT. These systems offer fast workflows that resemble conventional IGRT workflows and are ideal for high-throughput environments. MRgRT, on the other hand, remains indispensable for more challenging cases where soft tissue contrast, real-time imaging, or functional imaging is critical. For example, in liver, pancreas, or rectal cancers, MRgRT enables visualization of structures that are poorly defined on CT, or in cases with mobile tumors, Elekta Unity with real time motion monitoring allows safe delivery of ablative doses. Do you need a dedicated system for online Adaptive Radiotherapy? No, with Elekta Linacs online adaptive is a workflow, not a system. With Elekta ONE® Online, adaptive radiotherapy is accessible on versatile C-arm Linacs, with full flexibility to decide per fraction whether adaptation is beneficial, or whether a standard IGRT workflow can be followed. Elekta ONE Online is also available as an upgrade for Evo and Versa HD® systems, expanding access to adaptive radiotherapy without requiring the purchase of a new Linac. How long does a typical online adaptive session take? The duration varies depending on the treatment modality (MR-Linac or CT-Linac) and complexity of the case. On Evo with Elekta ONE Online, adaptive sessions typically fit within standard treatment slots. For prostate and bladder cases, clinicians report completing the full workflow, from setup to delivery, in under 20 minutes. As the plan can be optimized to the anatomy of the day, clinicians report fewer instances of repositioning or sending patients to empty their bladder. Treatments with Elekta Unity for prostate, oligometastatic, and brain cases typically fit within 30-minute slots, while more complex treatments, such as pancreas or liver SBRT with gating and ablative doses, may require up to 45 minutes. These longer sessions should be considered in the context of Unity’s high SBRT adoption (>55%) and widespread use of hypofractionation, which significantly reduces the total number of treatment sessions required. What is the role of offline Adaptive Radiotherapy? Offline adaptive radiotherapy allows clinicians to assess anatomical changes between fractions and replan when needed, without the time pressure of adapting the plan during a treatment session. This is particularly useful for cases with gradual anatomical changes or when workflow constraints make online adaptation impractical. With Elekta Evo and Elekta ONE Planning, offline adaptation becomes significantly faster and more accessible. With Iris® high-definition, AI-enhanced imaging enables immediate visualization of target boundaries and organs-at-risk. Advanced analysis tools support rapid plan assessment, and when re-planning is required, GPU-based dose calculation and optimization deliver adapted plans within minutes. This streamlined workflow reduces the burden traditionally associated with offline adaptation, making it easier to implement and allowing more patients to benefit from personalized treatment. With Elekta ONE Online, clinicians can flexibly choose between online and offline adaptation based on clinical need, patient anatomy, and departmental resources. How does Elekta support clinical adoption of online Adaptive Radiotherapy? The MR-Linac Consortium and the CT-Linac Adaptive Consortium play a pivotal role in driving the clinical adoption of online adaptive radiotherapy by fostering a collaborative, evidence-based ecosystem. These consortia bring together early adopters, clinical experts, and Elekta’s product teams to share best practices, establish clinical evidence, and co-develop future solutions. Through regular collaboration, clinicians gain practical insights and mentorship that support successful integration of Adaptive radiotherapy into daily practice, whether on Elekta Unity or CT-Linac systems. Applying mobilization therapy as early as the patients clinical status allow may reduce number of complications due to immobility. Sara Combilizer is multi-functional tool for mobilisation of patients out of bed in the acute care settings, in particular at ICU’s. It allows the patient to be positioned into lying, sitting and standing positions – all of them achievable without having to perform transfers in between. In all these positions Sara Combilizer can be sideways tilted as well, facilitating therapy and making it possible to safely and easily reposition the patient without strain on the caregiver. Unsere Hygiene- und Wellnesslösungen ermöglichen es der Pflegekraft und den Bewohnern, eine Wahl zu treffen, die ihren Bedürfnissen hinsichtlich der funktionellen Mobilität und ihren individuellen Vorlieben am besten entspricht. Hygieneroutinen für Pflegekräfte sicherer und einfacher gestalten Seit der Gründung von Arjo vor über sechzig Jahren steht die Verbesserung der Körperpflegeerfahrungen für Patienten, Bewohner und Pflegekräfte im Mittelpunkt unseres Handelns. Ohne Zugang zu geeigneten Hilfsmitteln kann die hygienische Versorgung gefährlich sein, da statische Überlastung und körperliche Belastung die Pflegekräfte einem Verletzungsrisiko aussetzen.² Unsere Lösungen ermöglichen es, dieses Risiko zu reduzieren und gleichzeitig wertvolle Zeit zu sparen.³ Klinische Entscheidungsfindung für Hygiene und Wohlbefinden Wir sind uns bewusst, dass die klinische Entscheidungsfindung komplex ist und auf den besten verfügbaren Erkenntnissen basieren sollte. Wir hoffen, dass diese Broschüre für Sie von Interesse ist. Sie enthält viele Beispiele, anhand derer der Nutzen von Hygiene- und Badelösungen belegt wird. Sie können die Zusammenfassung der klinischen Nachweise für sich herunterladen. Hier herunterladen Zubehör für mehr Komfort und eine würdevolle Pflege Mit dem Zubehör der Arjo Hygiene- und Komfortkollektion können Sie das Komfortniveau während der Hygieneroutinen anpassen, um eine würdevolle Pflege und einen Pflegeansatz zu gewährleisten, in dessen Mittelpunkt der Mensch steht. Lesen Sie unser Dokument zum klinischen Fokus zu Komfort und Würde in der Körperpflegeroutine. Hier herunterladen Hygienelösungen, die allen gerecht werden Wussten Sie, dass mit höhenverstellbaren Hygienehilfsmitteln täglich 5,2 Stunden eingespart werden können, und dass Pflegekräfte ohne richtige Ausrüstung häufig auch einem Verletzungsrisiko ausgesetzt sind?¹,³,⁴,⁶ Durch den Einsatz von höhenverstellbaren und ergonomischen Lösungen haben Sie Zeit für andere Tätigkeiten, bieten Wellnesserfahrungen und realisieren Kosteneinsparungen. Individuelle Pflege in gesunden Arbeitshaltungen Zur Erleichterung der täglichen Hygieneroutine bieten wir eine große Auswahl an Duschlösungen, die eine persönliche Interaktion mit dem Patienten oder Bewohner ermöglichen, während Sie in einer ergonomisch gesunden Position arbeiten. Unser Sortiment an Duschstühlen und -wagen ist im Hinblick auf Qualität, Effizienz, Komfort und Würde für alle Mobilitätsstufen ausgelegt und wird auch den Anforderungen hinsichtlich der Sicherheit und des Zeitaufwands der Pflegekräfte gerecht. Alle Duschlösungen anzeigen Reduzierung des Risikos für Pflegekräfte während des begleiteten Badens Seit Jahrhunderten gilt das Baden als angenehmes und entspannendes Erlebnis. Es dient der grundlegenden Körperpflege und kann darüber hinaus das Wohlbefinden fördern. Ein warmes Bad entspannt sowohl den Körper als auch die Seele.⁵ Für Personen mit eingeschränkter Mobilität und verminderter kognitiver Funktion wird das Baden umso wichtiger. Während des Badens kann der Bewohner oder Patient ermutigt werden, aktiv teilzunehmen und sich selbst zu waschen, soweit dies möglich ist. Dadurch erhält er die Gelegenheit, seine Würde und ein Maß an Eigenständigkeit zu wahren. Alle Badelösungen anzeigen Badelifter – für den Transfer während der Baderoutine Der Einsatz eines Badelifters zur Reduzierung des Sturzrisikos des Bewohners/Patienten und zur Vermeidung einer Überlastung der Pflegekraft ist in den meisten Fällen zu empfehlen. Unsere Badelösungen sind mit vielen Badeliftern, Hebe- und Transferlösungen kombinierbar, sodass Sie die Bewohner und Patienten vom Bett oder Rollstuhl aus in das Bad – und wieder zurück – bringen können. detail.description: Oticon Remote Control offers an intuitive, straightforward and discreet way to operate your hearing aids. With the remote control, you can perform the most common everyday adjustments without drawing attention to your hearing aids.
features: Full discretion: The remote control can operate your hearing aids from a distance of up to 1.8 metres without a direct line of sight between the remote control and the hearing aid.

Easy to operate: Every time a button is pressed, a notification is heard in your hearing aids. At the same time, the remote control confirms the action with a visual indication and a discreet click that can be heard and felt.

Perform the most common everyday adjustments: • Volume up/down
• Change programme
• Mute your hearing aids

detail.description: Behind-the-ear hearing aids Easy to use and comfortable to wear Hearing aids that sit behind your ears are simple to put on and take off, so they fit easily into your daily life. You’ll find many different behind-the-ear styles to choose from. Small and surprisingly discreet Modern hearing aids hide behind your ears and are made to blend in with your skin or hair colour so other people needn’t notice you have them at all. Simply connect to what matters most Oticon behind-the-ear hearing aids connect effortlessly via Bluetooth® wireless technology or an accessory, letting you transform your everyday devices such as your phone, computer, and TV. Then you can use your hearing aids as a headset for hands-free calls, stream music, podcasts and other audio into your hearing aids, personalise your hearing aids with the Oticon Companion app, and more. Engage in life like never before with Oticon Intent Discover Oticon Intent Loading component...

Children and teens Supporting your child’s development Our hearing aids for children are designed to give your child’s brain the sound information it needs to ensure optimal communication. Paediatric hearing aids with BrainHearing™ technology As your child's brain develops, it needs consistent sound from the environment. Access to communication is vital for learning speech and language, and for developing social skills.Oticon’s unique BrainHearing™ technology ensures the brain has balanced access to the sound all around, supporting the way the brain naturally makes sense of sound. Simply connect to what matters most Oticon hearing aids connect effortlessly via Bluetooth® wireless technology or an accessory, letting you transform your everyday devices such as your phone, computer, and TV. Then you can use your hearing aids as a headset for hands-free calls, stream music, podcasts and other audio into your hearing aids, personalise your hearing aids with the Oticon Companion app, and more. Let's find a hearing aid your child will love Discover Oticon Play SI™ Loading component...

In-the-ear Custom Custom-made to fit your ears These hearing aids are moulded to fit entirely within the unique shape of your ears. They sit in your ear canal, where they discreetly help you live your life to the full. Can hearing aids be invisible? Some in-the-ear hearing aids are invisible because they are so small and well-hidden in your ear canals that people don’t see them. Others are larger and coloured to match your skin for maximum discreetness. Support the way your brain naturally works Your ears capture sounds, but it’s your brain that actually understands them. Oticon’s in-the-ear hearing aids feature our unique BrainHearing™ technology that supports the way your brain naturally makes sense of sound. Meet our most discreet custom hearing aids yet Discover Oticon Own SI Loading component...

More powerful hearing aids Extra amplification for your severe or profound hearing loss These hearing aids feature extra powerful amplification and specially designed audio technology, as well as Bluetooth® for streaming music and audio from phones and other devices. How are more powerful hearing aids different? More powerful hearing aids can provide louder sound and feature larger batteries, ensuring they can keep delivering the high levels of amplification you need. Dedicated technology The sound processing technology in our more powerful hearing aids is specially designed for people with severe-to-profound hearing loss. It improves the signal-to-noise ratio, which helps you understand more of what people say – especially in noisy and dynamic listening environments. Hear more speech with less effort Discover a hearing aid that supports the way your brain makes sense of sound. Explore Oticon Xceed Loading component...

detail.description: Reagents & Stains Papanicolaou Stain EA, Series R Papanicolaou Stain EA provides brilliant cytoplasmic staining for gynecological and non-gynecological specimens. EA-36, -50, -65 and Modified EA are ready-to-use cytoplasmic counterstains used for gynecological and non-gynecological cytology specimens. Request a Quote Request a Quote Overview A well-preserved or fixed slide with adequate exposure to 95% alcohol or a commercial spray fixative is highly recommended for optimal staining results. Cellular results are traditional as well, with basal or intermediate cells staining a blue-green hue and surface cells staining a pink-red hue. This multicolored effect is due to selective dye uptake by various cells and their affinities for the specific dyes. Different formulations offer the user control of the color intensities and hues EA-36 and EA-50 are used in conjunction with OG-6 for gynecological staining EA-65 is used with OG-6 for non-gynecological staining Modified EA is a Gill modification that minimizes precipitation, reduces staining time and does not contain Bismarck Brown; designed to be used with Modified OG Products Product Number Packaged As Action 75404: Papanicolaou Stain

detail.description: Tensi+ Conductive Gel is designed to be used with the Tensi+ medical device to help the electrodes make good contact with the skin. This helps ensure the electrical stimulation is delivered comfortably and consistently throughout the 20-minute treatment.

Tensi+ is an innovative, non-medicinal treatment option for people living with overactive bladder. During a simple 20-minute daily treatment, the device is placed comfortably at the ankle to deliver gentle electrical stimulation to the posterior tibial nerve. This stimulation may help improve bladder control and improve quality of life.

products.name: CliniShield® Advance 360° Foam & Spray Skin Cleanser

detail.description: Gently cleanses the skin . The cost-effective CliniShield Advance 360° Foam & Spray Skin Cleanser features innovative 360-degree technology that allows the skin cleanser to be discharged at any angle, including completely upside down. This functionality is a significant advantage for reaching difficult areas or assisting users with limited mobility. The device further enhances care through its dual-application modes: the foam mode provides a dense, localised texture ideal for managing heavy soiling while the spray mode offers a lighter, broader application suited for lighter cleaning and routine hygiene. The product may be used on adults and children.

Protects your skin. Prevents soreness. Preserves skin integrity. Our cost-effective CliniShield Advance Protective Barrier Cream offers protection for intact and injured skin prone to moisture damage. It is indicated for use in incontinence care, protecting skin from exposure to urine, faeces, and other bodily fluids. The protective barrier cream provides long-lasting, waterproof protection for up to 24 hours – perfect for soothing soreness from incontinence or skin folds. Its gentle formula ensures it will not block continence pads, so they stay fully absorbent. The protective barrier cream moisturises and provides a protective barrier restoring the skin’s hydration. The product may be used on adults and children.

Double the security. The Aura 2 Urostomy pouch connects to the Aura 2 Urostomy flange with a coupling system, with the extra benefit of an adhesive ring which provides additional security. With flat and convex flanges available, there’s an option which will ensure your secure and discreet two-piece fit. Our Aura 2 Urostomy flanges are specifically designed for urostomates, offering enhanced durability whilst still being flexible and comfortable. Promoting skin health. The skin-friendly Hyperflex ® hydrocolloid flange contains medical grade Manuka honey which may help promote healthy skin around the stoma. Made from all natural ingredients with no preservatives or tackifiers, Aura 2 provides reliable adhesion which is still kind and gentle for your skin. Our Manuka honey infused products have received dermatological accreditation from the Skin Health Alliance. This means you can be confident and assured that our products meet the highest standards of skin safety. Designed for incorporation into your daily life. With a super soft, water-repellent cover for comfortable wear and a split-back cover for simple application and monitoring of output, Aura 2 is designed to enhance your stoma care routine and to give you peace of mind throughout the day.

Unique range to help reduce skin trauma during adhesive dressing removal. The removal of adhesive medical devices and dressings is not only associated with increased nursing time due to the pain, anxiety and difficulty it can cause, but repeated application and removal can also cause damage and result in medical adhesive related skin injuries (MARSIs) such as skin stripping and can also increase the risk of infection. Appeel Sterile Medical Adhesive Remover is designed for quick and easy removal of medical adhesive devices and dressings, preventing MARSIs, reducing pain and the risk of infection. It can be used on intact and injured skin and is ideal for those with fragile skin such as babies and the elderly, or for blistering conditions like epidermolysis bullosa. Evidence shows that the inert fluid in Appeel Sterile Medical Adhesive Remover is not metabolised by the skin, ensuring that it is safe to use on injured skin and will not impact wound healing¹. All Appeel Sterile products are made of healthcare-grade silicones which are no-sting (alcohol-free) and dry quickly leaving no residue. This allows for adhesive medical devices and dressings to be re-applied shortly after use. 1 CliniMed data on file, 2010

products.name: Appeel® No Sting Medical Adhesive Remover

detail.description: The repeated application and removal of stoma pouches and their accessories can lead to peristomal skin damage and pain. Use of Appeel Advance Medical Adhesive Remover helps to protect skin, whilst reducing the risk of damaging peristomal skin or experiencing pain from repeated stoma bag changes. Appeel Advance is a product within stoma care for assisting in the removal of stoma bags. It is available in individual wipes and a spray that can be used at any angle.

products.name: CliniShield® Advance No Sting Barrier Film Range

detail.description: Protects your skin. Prevents soreness. Prepares skin surface. Skin contact with an adhesive appliance can leave the skin red and sore. The CliniShield Advance Barrier Film range protects your skin for up to 48 hours. By applying CliniShield Advance, you’ll create a waterproof barrier over your skin, keeping it safe from damage. CliniShield Advance creates a smooth, dry surface for the adhesive appliances to adhere to. This can improve the seal and potentially extend wear time by reducing leaks and the need for frequent changes. By creating a barrier and reducing irritation, CliniShield Advance can help maintain a healthy skin environment, which is crucial for healing and preventing further skin breakdown. The CliniShield Advance Range was specially formulated as an affordable option, providing quality care without stretching NHS budgets.

Protecting the skin is a complicated process that is often taken for granted until damage occurs. LBF Sterile Barrier Film provides a protective barrier against the harmful effects of bodily fluids such as wound exudate and excessive perspiration, which can cause maceration and irritation. It also helps to protect against pressure, friction and shear which can lead to the formation of pressure ulcers, as well as adhesive trauma caused by the repeated removal of adhesive medical devices and dressings. LBF Sterile Barrier Film dries rapidly on the skin, forming a breathable, long-lasting transparent barrier which helps to preserve skin integrity. The fluid remains sterile for each application, making it suitable for use on both intact and injured skin.

Protecting the skin is a complicated process that is often taken for granted until damage occurs. LBF Barrier Cream moisturises the skin whilst providing a protective barrier against the harmful effects of bodily fluids such as wound exudate and excessive perspiration, which can cause maceration and irritation. The cream is a skin-friendly formulation suitable for intact skin. The waterproof formulation offers long-lasting protection and will not block incontinence pad absorbency. The cream’s balanced consistency makes it easy to apply and spread across the skin, which maximises coverage and reduces application time. Its highly concentrated formula covers a large area of skin, so a little cream goes a long way. It also helps to protect against pressure, friction and shear which can lead to the formation of pressure ulcers. LBF Barrier Cream is ideal for fragile skin as the barrier helps to prevent adhesive trauma and skin stripping caused by the repeated removal of adhesive medical devices and dressings.

The CliniPeel Medical Adhesive Removers spray (non-fragranced) and wipes contain silicone which effortlessly releases adhesive appliances such as stoma pouches and urinary sheaths from the skin to reduce skin trauma and pain. It’s fast drying, leaving no residue on the skin, which allows adhesive appliances to be re-applied shortly after use. It helps maintain skin integrity whilst assisting quick and easy adhesive appliance removal. Stoma pouch removal with CliniPeel Mint 2-in-1 The CliniPeel Medical Adhesive Remover Mint spray also contains silicone which aids in the quick and easy removal of stoma pouches. For an even fresher feel, try CliniPeel Mint 2-in-1, delicately scented with pure peppermint oil. The added fresh peppermint scent helps mask odours between pouch changes and eliminates the need for an additional deodoriser. Our CliniPeel Range of skin care products are cost-effective without compromising on quality and are able to provide a cost saving to the NHS.

products.name: HyperSeal Mouldable Seals with Manuka Honey

detail.description: HyperSeal Mouldable Seals with Manuka Honey seal the gap between the stoma and the skin around the stoma, providing extra security when the pouch is applied. They are flexible and mouldable, so help to fill in dips and creases around the stoma. Skin friendly Gentle and nurturing, Manuka honey provides additional comfort and is kind to the skin around the stoma. The hydrocolloid is made from all natural ingredients, without any preservatives or tackifiers, so provides gentle but reliable adhesion around uneven stoma areas. Our Manuka honey infused products have received dermatological accreditation from the Skin Health Alliance. This means you can be confident and assured that our products meet the highest standards of skin safety. Versatile and adaptable HyperSeal moulds around all body contours. They can be stretched, shaped, moulded, or cut to fit around the stoma, ensuring a secure fit. Long-lasting adhesion HyperSeal Mouldable Seals with Manuka Honey maintain their stickiness and can be re-joined if they break, providing reliable adhesion and maintaining effectiveness to provide security for the stoma pouch.

Gentle and effective. Welland Stoma Paste is alcohol-free and hypoallergenic, ensuring it won’t cause stinging or irritation upon application. It’s suitable for most skin types, providing comfort and peace of mind. Smooth and secure seal. Its unique formula smooths and levels minor skin irregularities, creating a perfect base for your stoma bag. By creating this perfect seal, the risk of leaks behind the flange is reduced, preventing related skin irritation and damage. Easy application. The soft, squeezable tube makes applying Welland Stoma Paste effortless. It remains pliable throughout application, allowing for flexibility in moulding and smoothing over scar lines. Long-lasting performance. Welland Stoma Paste offers durable and long-lasting performance, providing a secure hold for your stoma bag throughout the day. Its reliable adhesion prevents leakage and helps prevent sore skin, promoting overall comfort and confidence. Compatibility. Compatible with both one-piece and two-piece stoma pouches and systems, Welland Stoma Paste is versatile and adaptable to various ostomy care routines. This compatibility ensures it can be seamlessly integrated into your preferred stoma care routine.

For flush or recessed stomas that need gentle support to help bring the stoma out into the pouch. Suitable for people whose stoma sits level with or below the skin, or who have skin creases and folds that can make getting a secure fit more challenging. Limone comes in a simple to use spray can which can be used at any angle.

Morform Motion Management Sachets are specially formulated for dealing with very liquid output. Whether you’re at home or travelling, Morform helps control your stoma output, reducing pouch bulging, minimising discomfort and managing noise.

products.name: HydroFrame® Flange Extenders with Manuka Honey

detail.description: Additional adhesion to secure your pouch. Whether you’re putting extra pressure on your flange whilst gardening or doing the housework, or whether you need extra support around creases, skin-folds or hernias, HydroFrame can provide the extra security you need to keep your flange in place and reduce the risk of leaks. Infused with Manuka honey. The skin-friendly hydrocolloid contains medical grade Manuka honey, which is known for its therapeutic properties and may help to promote healthy skin around the stoma. HydroFrame is made from all natural ingredients with no preservatives or tackifiers, providing reliable but gentle adhesion with less risk of trauma when removing the extender. Our Manuka honey infused products have received dermatological accreditation from the Skin Health Alliance. This means you can be confident and assured that our products meet the highest standards of skin safety. Choose your preferred size. Also available as a smaller Mini version, great for smaller areas where adhesion is required or for use as an alternative to more aggressive medical tape.

UltraFrame is a flange extender designed to be applied over the edges of your stoma pouch, providing extra security and preventing the edges of the pouch from lifting. Great for active ostomates or anyone putting their pouch to the test. When security matters most. UltraFrame Film Flange Extenders offer additional security precisely when you need it. Whether you’re hitting the gym or enjoying water-based activities, UltraFrame keeps your flange securely in place, providing peace of mind throughout the day. Discreet protection. With its unique ultra-thin, low-profile, and transparent film, UltraFrame ensures discreet protection under clothing and when the pouch is exposed. You can even view the condition of the skin underneath, giving you confidence in your ostomy care routine. Withstand the pressures of everyday. UltraFrame’s waterproof design maintains integrity and shape even when in contact with water, making it ideal for bathing, swimming, and active lifestyles. Comfortable wear. Experience comfort like never before with UltraFrame. The smooth and lightweight film allows the skin underneath to breathe, acting and feeling like a second skin. You’ll forget it’s even there, allowing you to focus on living life to the fullest.

Confidence in every detail. Aura Stoma Cap provides peace of mind with its discreet design and reliable performance. Much smaller than a standard stoma bag, it’s ideal for short-term wear, offering protection during everyday activities, sports, and water-based activities. Comfort and convenience. Designed for comfort, Aura Stoma Cap features an integral absorbent pad to absorb leaks and protect the stoma during various activities. Lightweight and convenient, it ensures discretion during bathing, showering, swimming, and intimate moments. Ideal for use following irrigation, it offers a discreet alternative between scheduled irrigations. Meet your need for comfort and discretion. Aura Stoma Cap features a hydrocolloid flange infused with medical-grade Manuka honey for enhanced comfort and skin protection. Irrigation cadence, medicine and irrigation, device lifetime and pin code questions. Q: How often should I perform TAI? A: At the start it is common to irrigate once every day for the first 10-14 days. Later on, the frequency may possibly be reduced to once every other day or every third day. The frequency should be decided in consultation with a healthcare professional. Q: Can I stop using stool modifying medicine when I start using Navina Irrigation System? A: TAI is usually part of a bowel management program. It is possible that you may be able to reduce the amount of laxative they are using eventually but you may have to continue using some to ensure that the stools have the right consistency to ensure easy evacuation. It is best to continue with your current laxative regimen until you are getting regular results from TAI. Consult a healthcare professional before changing your personal regimen. Q: How long does the procedure take? A: It is very individual but the aim is that the bowel management routine will take less than one hour. Symptoms questions in conjunction with irrigation. Q: What if bleeding should occur? A: A small amount of bleeding or smearing of blood on the cone may occur and should not alarm you. More severe or sustained rectal bleeding with or without pain suggests a possible bowel perforation, which should be treated as a medical emergency and requires immediate medical attention. Q: What should I do if I feel pain? A: If cramps, discomfort, or pain occur while instilling the water, pause instillation for a few moments and continue more slowly once the discomfort has subsided, ensure that the water is warm enough, at body temperature. If pain is severe or persistent stop the irrigation immediately. It could be perforation of the bowel which should be treated as a medical emergency. Q: What if I feel sweating, palpitations or dizziness during irrigation? A: If you have a spinal cord injury this may be a sign of autonomic dysreflexia. Water and device questions related to instillation. Q: Why can’t I get from priming to instillation with my Navina Smart? A: Occasionally small amounts of water can get trapped inside the Navina Smart control unit. To prevent this from happening, make sure to always follow the order of the disassembly instructions given in the IFU (disconnect tubes before pressing the power-button on the unit). If the unit is already stuck in priming mode, try placing the water container higher than the catheter and squeezing the water container gently during the priming step. This increases the water flow and may dislodge the trapped water. Q: How much water should I instill? ADULTS: A healthcare professional will advise you how much water should be used. It should be just big enough to hold the catheter in place and seal the anal opening to minimize leakage during irrigation. Apnea : A cessation of airflow for ≥10 seconds.

Obstructive sleep apnea : The most common form of sleep disordered breathing (SDB). A partial or complete collapse of the upper airway caused by relaxation of the muscles controlling the soft palate and tongue.

Central sleep apnea : A type of sleep disorder that occurs when the respiratory control center in the brain fails to send a signal to the muscles that control your breathing during sleep. CSA causes you to repeatedly stop and start breathing during the night.

Mixed sleep apnea : A combination of OSA (absence of airflow but continued respiratory effort) and CSA (absence of airflow and respiratory effort). It often starts with central apnea episodes followed by obstructive apnea events.
Periodic breathing : Clusters of breaths separated by periodic intervals of not breathing (apnea) or near-apnea, as opposed to normal breathing.

detail.description: Timesco R Engines – A quick, simple and low cost solution to convert existing dry cell laryngoscope handles to a rechargeable version. Simply replace the dry cell batteries with the equivalent Timesco R engine. Product Code Description 3115.150.20 Timesco R Engine Small (AA size), 2.5v 3115.150.50 Timesco R Engine Medium (C Size), 2.5v Timesco R engines are guaranteed for 3 years. The engines convert Timesco reusable handles to a rechargeable system. No special end caps/modifications required (excluding stubby handles). The batteries use Lithium Ion technology to provide quick charging in an ION-R charger, (typically takes approx. 4 hours to fully charge batteries for medium handles) and deliver consistent and reliable power. Adaptors/Inserts are used to ensure that both engine sizes fit into the ION-R charger. The ION-R charger is an innovative, patented (patent number 2494141), intelligent and efficient lithium recharger for use with ION-R engines and Timesco-R engines. Once engines are fully charged the recharger will switch to a low power mode to avoid using unnecessary electricity. Only the engine is inserted into the charger, reducing the risk of cross contamination from a handle to the charger. The ION-R charger (single and daisy chained) takes approx. 4 hours to fully charge batteries for medium handles. A fully charged Timesco R Engine Medium (C Size) will last approx. 2 hours The colour changing LED indicates the health of the battery and the charging cycle. Side plates can be removed to daisy chain 3 chargers together to receive power from a single power supply.

Commonly known as Alligator or Hartmann forceps, after German physician Arthur Hartmann, each instrument has a matt black finish with small jaws that allow accurate clinical precision and control. Introducing an exclusive, all-in-one support package designed to elevate outcomes in repositioning, tissue viability, and mobilisation. The Aria Turn+ Therapy System creates a truly unmatched solution for the care of plus-size patients. This package is exclusive to Medstrom and is designed to overcome the most common challenges in clinical practice, enabling caregivers to get closer to the patient, simplify complex repositioning tasks, and support safer, more dignified mobilisation.
The Vela XL Stretcher is a versatile extra-wide stretcher supporting improved patient care throughout a hospital stay.

products.name: Aria Lateral Tilt Bed and Dolphin Therapy

detail.description: This unique bed and surface duo combines full platform lateral tilt and exceptional immersion. It offers an ideal solution for the most complex patients, in both critical care and general ward environments. In addition to outstanding pressure area care, benefits include easier patient repositioning and care, and improved caregiver efficiency.

Designed with both safety and convenience in mind, the AER Magna is a bariatric dynamic air mattress with an adjustable width from 90 to 120cm. Combined with the Versatech 1100, the AER Magna provides effective protection against pressure ulcers while maintaining patient comfort and dignity.

Designed for full compatibility with the Medstrom Solo Luxe bed frame, the advanced construction of the Protecta Luxe offers enhanced skin and pressure ulcer protection for a wide variety of patients.

For a growing patient population with complex mental and physical problems, there’s a need for mattress solutions that prioritise safety without compromising on clinical outcomes. The Protecta 7 has been specifically designed as a solution to these challenges, providing enhanced skin protection in even the most high-risk scenarios.
Uniquely suitable for children, adults and adults with atypical anatomy, the Solo Luxe offers enhanced protection and safety for all.

It’s time for change. The ECO portable patient shower is the future of patient hygiene, utilising innovative hydro-molecular technology. The result? Patient dignity and experience restored, up to 65% reduction in caregiver time and up to 95% water reduction than a traditional bed bath.

The 360Care+ Package is an innovative rental package that provides effective falls management and safe mobilisation, increases nursing efficiency and improves patient outcomes.
As the temperatures drop, Medstrom is here to support with escalation preparation.

With an established range of bariatric equipment, including two known and widely used bed frames, Medstrom is delighted to exclusively introduce the Versatech 1100 bariatric bed to its growing portfolio, significantly adding to the solutions available. The Versatech 1100 is a width adjustable, ultra-low bed with a high safe working load of 500kg and additional high specification benefits such as Class III weigh scales, bed exit alarms and a range of electric profiling functionality.

The Medstrom Aria cushion is designed to be ultra-portable and compact, with its own control unit accompanied by a 12-hour battery life to acknowledge the drawbacks with traditional systems. Equipped with an ultra-low profile of just 6.5cm and innovative cubed cells, the cushion ensures safe mobilisation to and from a chair without compromising on therapeutic benefits.

The Riser Recliner PRO is the latest advancement in riser recliner functionality, achieving a bespoke seating solution for every patient. UK manufactured and available in different widths from 20” through to 38”, the PRO range has been specially adapted to deliver reassuring stability and support, helping to promote early patient mobilisation.
A unique and highly versatile hospital bed with an unrivalled height range for maximum patient and caregiver safety.
Medstrom is here to support you over the festive period with specialist product rental, equipped with round-the-clock clinical and technical support.
Discover the Aria Junior, specifically designed for paediatrics, providing optimal therapy and immersion whilst enhancing comfort.
Discover the advanced semi-dynamic support surface that offers immediate protection from pressure ulcers and behaves like a dynamic mattress, even in non-powered mode.

The Oxford Calibre is an ergonomically designed mobile patient hoist for the safe lifting of plus-size patients. Sturdy and robust, with a safe working load of 385kg (60 stone), it is specifically designed to meet the unique demands of bariatric care.

The Pro-Bario Active bed is designed for plus-size users living at home with complex needs. The wide sleep platform provides comfort and support to the user, and the electric controls help protect caregivers from manual handling injury. This bariatric bed is safely assembled inside the user’s home by qualified technicians, easy to clean and durable. A range of compatible surfaces and accessories is available.

Understanding the risks involved in safeguarding both clients and caregivers, the SoloMH bed is an innovative four-section, electric profiling bed frame that has several adaptations to optimise safety and provide enhanced protection.

Optima Juve is a therapeutic support system suitable for both the treatment of existing pressure ulcers category I-IV as well as for children who have been assessed to be at high risk from complications of immobility. The surface compromises two layers of air cells, with the top layer being pre-filled to allow greater immersion. The closed air system automatically adjusts to individual patient weight, providing excellent pressure redistribution.

A unique combination of full platform lateral tilt with unrivalled immersion. This helps improve outcomes, enhance patient care, and increase caregiver efficiency, both inside and outside intensive care.
Clinically and technologically advanced fluid immersion simulation therapy has transformed the prevention and treatment of pressure ulcers for the most complex patients.

Equipped with a unique and patented valve system and semi-dynamic technology, P.R.O. Matt Plus in non-powered mode, is able to achieve a pressure profile similar to that of a dynamic air mattress. This offers significantly higher therapy than a foam mattress and a traditional hybrid system and means patients are protected immediately. If the patient requires a ‘step up’, cell-in-cell technology allows a control unit to be added, converting the system to powered therapy and uniquely offering both alternating and continuous low pressure.
Dolphin Therapy extra-wide, suitable for bariatric beds, is the ideal choice of surface for complex and difficult-to-manage plus-size patients.

The TurnCair 1000 low air loss bariatric mattress provides a high specification of support surface for pressure redistribution, plus a TurnAssist feature that enables safe handling of patients. The TurnAssist feature facilitates easy manual handling for personal care and positional changes, easy changes of linen, inserting slide sheets and positional changes that can be carried out with one nurse.

Equipped with a unique and patented valve system and semi-dynamic technology, P.R.O. Matt Plus Extra-Wide in non-powered mode, is able to achieve a pressure profile similar to that of a dynamic air mattress. This offers significantly higher therapy than a foam mattress and a traditional hybrid system and means patients are protected immediately. If the patient requires a ‘step up’, cell-in-cell technology allows a control unit to be added, converting the system to powered therapy and uniquely offering both alternating and continuous low pressure.

The Neo is one of the only surfaces available specifically designed for neonates that have been compromised and at high risk of skin breakdown. The intelligent controller registers individual patient weight to provide a reactive support surface, even for the smallest of babies. Two versions available for compatibility with incubators and infant warmers.

The TurnCair low air loss mattress provides a high specification of support surface for pressure redistribution, plus a TurnAssist feature that enables safe handling of patients. The TurnAssist feature facilitates easy manual handling for personal care and positional changes, easy changes of linen, inserting slide sheets and positional changes that can be carried out with one nurse.

The Medstrom Bariatric Tilt-in-Space chair provides a versatile seating and transport solution for high dependency plus-size patients. Multiple positions can be effortlessly achieved via an intuitive electrically operated handset, providing comfort for the patient and removing moving and handling risks for the caregiver.

The Bariatric Rotunda provides a safe and dignified method for plus-size patients to transition between a bed, seat, commode or wheelchair. Simple to use, the robust frame offers greater reassurance when mobilising, with highly visible feet and hand points for extra stability. Caregivers can then easily pivot patients between five different positions, significantly reducing the manual handling effort required.
A unique and highly versatile hospital bed with an unrivalled height range for maximum patient and caregiver safety.

Clinicians often have to settle for the “closest fit”, which may not always yield optimal results.
Custom-made biodegradable stents, like those from Ella CS, offer a tailored approach that can better match the anatomy and healing profile of the patient.
Custom ERCP and CE marked Transhepatic options available.
Tracheal and bronchial stenting for complex benign airway disease can be extremely challenging, especially in newborns with congenital tracheal anomalies .
Postnatal complications , such as malformed or underdeveloped airways, often require creative and cutting-edge solutions.
Using a biodegradable stent avoids some of the long-term risks associated with traditional metallic or silicone stents.
The case at GOSH involved a scaffold-based approach , where the BD stent helped maintain airway structure while the stem-cell tissue matured and integrated.

detail.description: Elasticated Spinal Support - AM Healthcare Group Hit enter to search or ESC to close Search Close Search [vc_single_image image=”2486″ img_size=”full”] What is it? Usually comprises a one piece elastic panel which wraps around the area of the lower back and is secured by a velcro strip and/or straps depending on the design. A silicone sleeve containing within it a thermoplastic shell. The silicone sleeve extends from approximately mid-calf to the ball area of the foot. It opens along the posterior (back) section of the leg and has an opening at the heel area. The posterior opening is secured with velcro closures. What does it do? It applies a lifting force to the foot to allow for clearance when the foot swings through and its design allows for a very flexible, thin and cosmetic AFO. The inclusion of thermoplastic within the Orthosis provides more structural control than is available when using a purely silicone device. It is not suitable for all foot drop types. A shell which extends from above the ankle bones to underneath the foot. It may extend to the ball of the foot or to the end of the foot depending on individual requirements. A thigh and calf shell connected by either a single (positioned on one side of the knee) or double (positioned one on each side of the knee) jointed strut(s). The shells are secured by velcro fastenings. One strut is adjustable to apply either a valgus (pushing the knee inward) or varus (pushing the knee outward) corrective force. What does it do? They act as a conformer by keeping the punctal opening dilated for several weeks, allowing tears to be drained through. Details: PVP Perforated Plugs • Designed by J.-A. Rapid screening test for Chlamydia trachomatis infection. The Chlamydia trachomatis Antigen Rapid Test Cassette is a qualitative lateral flow immunoassay designed for the detection of Chlamydia trachomatis antigen in clinical specimens such as urine or swabs, depending on the test configuration. Chlamydia infection is often asymptomatic, making screening an essential part of sexual health programmes. This rapid test delivers results within minutes, supporting timely identification and referral for further clinical management. For professional in vitro diagnostic use only

Rapid semi‑quantitative screening of prostate‑specific antigen levels. The PSA Rapid Test Cassette is a semi‑quantitative lateral flow immunoassay for the detection of prostate‑specific antigen (PSA) in whole blood, serum or plasma. Elevated PSA levels may be associated with prostate cancer, benign prostatic hyperplasia or prostatitis. This test provides rapid screening results to support early clinical assessment and monitoring in professional healthcare and urology settings. For professional in vitro diagnostic use only

Rapid powder screening for synthetic nitazene opioids in harm reduction and forensic settings The Nitazene Powder Test Cassette is a rapid immunoassay device designed to screen dissolved powder samples for the presence of nitazenes. Nitazines are a group of potent synthetic opioids increasingly associated with fatal overdose incidents. Operating at a cut-off of 2000 ng/mL, the cassette delivers a visual result in 5 minutes from a prepared powder solution, without laboratory analysis. It is a valuable tool for drug checking services, harm reduction organisations, forensic drug testing teams and law enforcement agencies seeking to identify high-risk synthetic opioids in seized or submitted substances. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on drug parameters and cut‑off levels.

Rapid urine test for GHB detection at 10 µg/mL for clinical and forensic use The gamma-hydroxybutyrate (GHB) Test Cassette is a rapid immunoassay device that detects GHB in urine at a cut-off of 10 µg/mL. GHB is a central nervous system depressant associated with recreational misuse and drug-facilitated sexual assault. Because GHB clears from the body rapidly, often within 4-8 hours of ingestion, fast testing is critical in clinical and forensic settings. The cassette format requires only 3 drops of urine and delivers a clear visual result in 5 minutes, making it practical for emergency departments, sexual assault referral centres (SARCs) and forensic drug testing programmes. For professional use only

Rapid urine testing for Nicotine and Tobacco exposure screening The Cotinine Cassette is a rapid immunoassay test that detects cotinine – the primary metabolite of nicotine – in urine. As the main breakdown product of nicotine from tobacco and e-cigarettes, cotinine provides a reliable biomarker for tobacco and nicotine product use. Results are available within minutes with no laboratory equipment required, making the test practical for smoking cessation programmes, occupational health checks and insurance or pre-employment screening. Available in two cut-off configurations to suit different screening requirements: COT100 (100 ng/mL) for sensitive detection of light exposure; COT200 (200 ng/mL) for standard smoking status screening. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on drug parameters and cut‑off levels.

Rapid, portable surface drug test for detecting trace drug residues from powders or surfaces, with results in 5 minutes DrugTrace is a non-invasive, surface-based drug residue detection test that screens for 8 drug classes from swabbed surfaces or dissolved powder samples. No biological specimen is required from individuals. The 8 panel test simultaneously detects amphetamine, cocaine, fentanyl, ketamine, MDMA, methamphetamine, opiates and cannabis from a single surface swab and buffer solution. Results are available in 5 minutes. DrugTrace is designed for prisons, probation services, workplaces, border control, law enforcement and any setting where surface contamination monitoring or non-invasive drug detection is required. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on drug parameters and cut‑off levels.

Chain of Custody hair sample collection kit for confirmatory laboratory drug testing The Hair Drug Confirmation Kit is a complete professional collection kit for gathering, packaging and despatching hair samples to an accredited laboratory for confirmatory drug testing. Hair testing provides a significantly longer detection window than urine or oral fluid. A standard 3 cm head hair sample reflects approximately 0-3 months of drug use history, and extended history testing is possible with longer samples. The kit is used in workplace investigations, child safeguarding assessments, legal proceedings, insurance programmes and any situation where a robust, defensible, long-window drug use history is required. The kit includes all materials for a standardised, Chain of Custody compliant collection. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on drug parameters and cut‑off levels.

products.name: Covid-19 IgG/IgM Antibody Rapid Test Cassette

detail.description: Rapid screening of IgG and IgM antibodies to SARS‑CoV‑2. The COVID‑19 IgG/IgM Rapid Test Cassette is a lateral flow immunoassay designed for the qualitative detection of IgG and IgM antibodies to SARS‑CoV‑2 in whole blood, serum or plasma samples. These antibodies may be present following previous exposure to the virus or as part of an immune response. IgM antibodies typically appear earlier in the immune response, while IgG antibodies may persist for a longer period. Combined IgG/IgM detection supports antibody screening and serological assessment when interpreted alongside clinical evaluation and patient history. The test delivers results within minutes using a simple cassette format suitable for point‑of‑care and laboratory settings. The COVID‑19 IgG/IgM Rapid Test Cassette is intended for professional in vitro diagnostic use only and should not be used for the diagnosis of acute SARS‑CoV‑2 infection. For professional in vitro diagnostic use only

Rapid saliva alcohol screening using a simple dip and read test strip. The Alcohol Rapid Test Strip is a simple, instrument‑free solution for the qualitative detection of alcohol in saliva. Based on enzymatic oxidation technology, the strip produces a colour change proportional to alcohol concentration, covering a range from 0.02% to 0.30%. Designed for professional use, it delivers fast, easy‑to‑interpret results within minutes, making it suitable for workplace screening, occupational health programmes and on‑site alcohol checks where immediate decision‑making is required. For professional use only . Please refer to the references page for information on alcohol cut‑off levels.

7 parameter urine validity strips for detecting specimen tampering and substitution Adulteration Strips are rapid test strips that simultaneously assess 7 specimen validity parameters from a single urine dip, helping to identify samples that may have been tampered with, diluted or substituted. Parameters include pH, creatinine, nitrites, bleach, glutaraldehyde, PCC (pyridinium chlorochromate) and specific gravity. Detecting adulterated specimens is a critical quality control step in drug testing programmes, particularly in workplace and forensic settings where the integrity of results must be assured. Strips deliver clear colour-change results immediately after dipping, with no additional equipment required. For professional use only

Simple temperature verification for urine specimens This single-use temperature strip attaches to a urine specimen container and gives an immediate visual reading to confirm the sample is within the expected body temperature range of 32-39°C. Checking specimen temperature is a straightforward way to detect samples that may have been substituted or tampered with during collection. It is a standard part of many workplace and forensic drug testing protocols. For professional use only

On the spot screening for GHB, ketamine and benzodiazepines in drinks DrinkSpike is a rapid 3 panel dip card test that screens drinks for three substances most commonly associated with drink spiking: GHB (gamma-hydroxybutyrate), ketamine and benzodiazepines. The card is simply dipped into the suspect drink and results are read in 5 minutes. No specialist knowledge, equipment or laboratory is required. DrinkSpike is compact, discreet and designed for use in bars, clubs, universities, events and any setting where personal safety is a priority. It can be used on alcoholic and non-alcoholic drinks. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on drug parameters and cut‑off levels.

Chain of Custody urine drug confirmation kit for laboratory verified drug test results. The Urine Drug Confirmation Kit is a professional grade sample collection and packaging kit used to send urine specimens to an accredited laboratory for confirmatory drug testing. Designed to meet Chain of Custody requirements, it is suitable for workplace investigations, clinical settings, legal proceedings and forensic drug testing where a defensible, laboratory confirmed result is required. The kit contains all necessary components for secure, tamper-evident sample collection, sealing and despatch. Confirmatory analysis is performed using LC-MS/MS or equivalent technology at an approved laboratory. Fast, donor friendly oral fluid drug test for on-site, rehab and clinical screening. SureSwab Rapid is a streamlined oral fluid drug screening device designed for faster collection and quicker results than standard oral fluid tests. A click-activated swab mechanism ensures accurate sample insertion, while a red saturation indicator confirms sufficient saliva collection in as little as 30 seconds. Available in a 7 panel configuration covering amphetamine, benzodiazepines, cocaine, methamphetamine, ketamine, opiates and cannabis. SureSwab Rapid is CE-marked and suitable for workplace, occupational health and on-site drug testing where speed and ease of use are critical. Results are available in 10 minutes. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on drug parameters and cut‑off levels.

products.name: On Call® Blood Glucose & Ketone Monitoring System

detail.description: Integrated blood glucose and ketone monitoring system for routine metabolic health management. The On Call® Blood Glucose & Ketone Monitoring System supports routine monitoring of blood glucose and β‑ketone levels using compatible test strips and a dual‑function meter. Designed for wellness and metabolic health management, the system enables regular monitoring to support diabetes management and ketone awareness. Components are intended for in vitro diagnostic use with capillary whole blood samples and provide clear, digital results when used according to the relevant Instructions for Use. For self testing and professional use

Rapid semi‑quantitative screening of C‑reactive protein (CRP) to support the assessment of inflammation and infection risk. The CRP semi-quantitative rapid test cassette is designed to provide fast and accurate measurement of C-reactive protein, supporting infection and inflammation assessment in professional healthcare settings. The test cassette is a lateral flow immunoassay designed for the detection of C‑reactive protein (CRP) in whole blood, serum or plasma samples. CRP is a non‑specific inflammatory marker that may be elevated in response to infection, tissue injury or inflammatory disease. The test delivers a semi-quantitative result by categorising CRP concentrations into clinically relevant ranges. This supports the assessment and monitoring of inflammatory conditions and may assist healthcare professionals in evaluating the likelihood of bacterial infection when interpreted alongside clinical findings and other diagnostic information. Results are available within minutes using a simple cassette format suitable for both point-of-care and laboratory environments. The test is designed for professional use and provides a rapid screening solution where timely inflammation assessment is required. For professional in vitro diagnostic use only

Convenient midstream urine test for rapid hCG detection. The Pregnancy Test Midstream is a rapid, one‑step lateral flow immunoassay for the qualitative detection of human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) in urine. The midstream format allows direct urine application without the need for additional collection devices, providing a convenient option for pregnancy screening in professional and supervised settings. For professional in vitro diagnostic use only.

Dip‑and‑read urine pregnancy test strip for hCG detection. The hCG Pregnancy Rapid Test Strip is a qualitative lateral flow immunoassay designed to detect human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) in urine specimens. The strip format offers a simple, cost‑effective solution for high‑volume pregnancy screening in professional settings. Results are available within minutes and are intended as a preliminary screening aid. For professional in vitro diagnostic use only.

Rapid qualitative detection of hCG to support early pregnancy screening. The hCG Pregnancy Rapid Test Cassette is a qualitative lateral flow immunoassay designed for the detection of human chorionic gonadotropin (hCG) in urine, serum or plasma specimens. hCG is produced shortly after implantation and is an established marker for early pregnancy detection. This test provides clear results within minutes and supports use in professional clinical and laboratory settings as a screening aid for pregnancy. For professional in vitro use only

products.name: Transferrin & Faecal Occult Blood Rapid Test Cassette

detail.description: Dual detection of occult blood and transferrin in stool samples. The Transferrin & Faecal Occult Blood Rapid Test Cassette is a qualitative immunoassay designed to detect both human haemoglobin and transferrin in stool specimens. Combined testing improves the detection of gastrointestinal bleeding from both upper and lower regions of the GI tract. This enhanced screening approach supports early identification of conditions associated with colorectal and upper gastrointestinal cancers. For professional use only

products.name: Group A Streptococcus pyogenes (Strep A) Antigen Rapid Test Cassette

detail.description: Rapid point‑of‑care screening for Group A Streptococcus infection. The Strep A Antigen Rapid Test Cassette detects Group A Streptococcus antigens from throat swab specimens. Producing results within minutes, it supports rapid assessment of streptococcal pharyngitis in clinical and primary care environments. For professional in vitro diagnostic use only

products.name: Influenza (Flu) A/B Antigen Combo Rapid Test Cassette

detail.description: Rapid point‑of‑care screening for Influenza A and Influenza B from a nasal swab. The Influenza A/B Antigen Rapid Test Cassette is a lateral flow immunoassay designed for the qualitative detection of Influenza A and Influenza B antigens from nasal swab specimens. Delivering clear results within minutes, it supports fast clinical decision‑making during respiratory infection assessment. The test is intended for professional use in point‑of‑care settings such as GP practices, clinics and healthcare environments where rapid differentiation of influenza types is required. For professional in vitro diagnostic use only

products.name: Covid-19 Antigen Rapid Test Cassette – Gold

detail.description: Reliable, rapid screening for SARS‑CoV‑2 antigen from nasal swab samples. The COVID‑19 Antigen Rapid Test Cassette is a lateral flow immunoassay designed for the qualitative detection of SARS‑CoV‑2 antigen from nasal swab specimens. Antigen testing supports the screening of individuals with suspected acute infection and aids infection control decision‑making when used alongside clinical assessment. Results are available within minutes using a simple cassette format suitable for point‑of‑care and laboratory settings. The test is intended for professional in vitro diagnostic use only and should not be used as the sole basis for diagnosis or patient management. For professional in vitro diagnostic use only

products.name: Faecal Occult Blood Rapid Test Cassette

detail.description: Rapid stool test for the qualitative detection of faecal occult blood. The Faecal Occult Blood (FOB) Rapid Test Cassette is a qualitative lateral flow immunoassay for the detection of human haemoglobin in faecal specimens. The presence of occult blood in stool may indicate gastrointestinal bleeding associated with conditions such as colorectal cancer, polyps or ulcers. The test delivers fast results at the point of care and does not require dietary restrictions, making it suitable for routine screening and early clinical assessment in professional healthcare settings. For professional in vitro diagnostic use only

products.name: Helicobacter Pylori Antigen Rapid Test Cassette

detail.description: Rapid stool antigen screening for active Helicobacter pylori infection. The H. pylori Antigen Rapid Test Cassette detects Helicobacter pylori antigens in stool specimens, supporting diagnosis of gastrointestinal infection associated with ulcers and gastritis. For professional in vitro diagnostic use only

products.name: Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) Antigen Rapid Test Cassette

detail.description: Rapid point‑of‑care RSV antigen detection from nasal swab specimens. The RSV Antigen Rapid Test Cassette is a lateral flow immunoassay for the qualitative detection of Respiratory Syncytial Virus antigens from nasal swab specimens. RSV is a common cause of respiratory infection, particularly in infants, young children and older adults. This test delivers clear results within minutes, supporting timely clinical assessment and infection management in professional healthcare settings. For professional in vitro diagnostic use only

Urine alcohol screening using ETG for extended detection after drinking. The ETG Urine Alcohol Test is a rapid screening test designed to detect ethyl glucuronide (EtG), a direct metabolite of alcohol, in urine at a cut‑off of 1000 ng/mL. Unlike saliva or breath tests that indicate recent alcohol use, ETG testing extends the detection window, identifying alcohol consumption for up to several days after drinking. The test is suited to professional screening programmes where alcohol abstinence or compliance monitoring is required, including workplace testing, occupational health and rehabilitation settings. Results are available within minutes using a simple dip and read format. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on alcohol cut‑off levels.

products.name: SARS-CoV-2 & Influenza (Flu) A/B Antigen Combo Rapid Test Cassette

detail.description: Combined antigen screening for Covid‑19 and Influenza A/B from one sample. The first dual test in the UK to be awarded CTDA approval. The SARS‑CoV‑2 & Influenza A/B Antigen Combo Rapid Test Cassette is a lateral flow immunoassay designed to detect Covid‑19 and Influenza A/B antigens from a single nasal swab. This combined approach supports efficient differential diagnosis of respiratory infections at the point of care, delivering fast results to aid clinical decision‑making. For professional in vitro diagnostic use only

Advanced breath alcohol screening with optional printed results. The Intoximeter is a professional breath alcohol screening device designed for organisations requiring enhanced functionality and robust testing workflows. Using fuel cell sensor technology, it delivers fast and consistent BrAC screening results from breath samples. In addition to direct breath testing, the Intoximeter supports passive and drink sniffer modes, allowing screening without a direct mouthpiece blow. Optional integrated printing provides immediate hard‑copy records, making the device suitable for structured workplace, clinical and compliance‑driven alcohol screening programmes. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on alcohol cut‑off levels.

Reliable breath alcohol screening using fuel cell sensor technology. The Alcometer is a professional breath alcohol tester designed to provide fast, reliable screening for alcohol using advanced fuel cell sensor technology. Measuring breath alcohol concentration (BrAC) across a range of 0.00 to 2.00 mg/L, it delivers clear digital results within seconds. Its compact, easy‑to‑use design makes it suitable for workplace screening, occupational health programmes and on‑site alcohol testing where quick, preliminary results are required. Built‑in warning indicators support alcohol policy thresholds while maintaining straightforward operation for professional users. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on alcohol cut‑off levels.

Dip‑and‑read urine reagent strips for rapid multiparameter screening. Urinalysis Reagent Strips are dip‑and‑read test strips designed for the rapid qualitative and semi‑quantitative detection of multiple parameters in urine, including glucose, protein, blood, ketones, pH, nitrite and leukocytes. Results provide valuable information relating to general metabolic status, kidney and urinary tract function, and overall health. These strips are intended for professional in vitro diagnostic use and can be read visually using a colour chart or instrumentally with urine chemistry analysers. For professional in vitro diagnostic use only

Non-invasive oral fluid multi-drug test for workplace and rehabilitation screening. SureSwab is an oral fluid (saliva) drug screening device that detects multiple drugs of abuse without the need for urine collection or restroom facilities. Using a sponge collector, the donor provides a saliva sample which is transferred to the integrated test cassette. A collection indicator confirms that sufficient sample has been obtained. Available in 8 and 10 panel configurations, SureSwab is CE marked and designed for use in workplace drug testing, ‘for cause’ testing, rehabilitation programmes and any setting where observed, non-invasive collection is important. Results are available in 10 minutes. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on drug parameters and cut‑off levels.

Flexible multi‑drug urine screening from a single low‑volume sample. The Multi‑cassette urine drug test offers flexible multi‑drug screening using individual cassettes from a single urine specimen. Designed for low sample volumes, it allows specific drug combinations to be tested simultaneously with results available in minutes. Its modular format is well suited to workplaces, laboratories and clinical settings requiring adaptable screening options. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on drug parameters and cut‑off levels.

Targeted, cost‑effective urine drug screening with fast, reliable results. The Single Drug Test Strip provides a simple and cost effective solution for targeted urine drug screening where only one analyte is required. Designed for professional use, it delivers clear visual results in minutes without the need for laboratory equipment. Its compact format makes it ideal for high volume testing programmes, workplace screening and clinical settings requiring focused testing for specific drugs. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on drug parameters and cut‑off levels.

High throughput dip‑and‑read urine drug screening in a single device. The Multi‑panel urine drug test houses multiple test strips in one dip‑and‑read device, enabling simultaneous screening for several drug classes. Designed for high throughput environments, it delivers results in minutes while reducing handling and simplifying workflow. Its robust construction and clear visual cues support consistent use in workplace and clinical screening programmes. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on drug parameters and cut‑off levels.

Fast, secure urine drug screening with integrated testing strips. The Rapid Cup is an all in one urine drug test cup designed for fast on‑site screening. Integrated test strips and built in validity indicators streamline the collection to result process, reducing handling and delivering results within minutes. Its secure, leak resistant design makes it ideal for workplace, clinical and mobile testing environments. For professional use only

All in one urine drug test cup with enhanced specimen security and rapid results. The Integrated Key Cup combines urine collection and multi‑drug screening in a single secure device. A built‑in activation key controls test initiation, reducing handling and supporting sample integrity. With clear results available in minutes and integrated validity checks, it is widely used in workplace, occupational health and forensic screening programmes where security, speed and ease of use are essential. For professional use only Please refer to the references page for information on drug parameters and cut‑off levels.
